title: Retail Pharmacist
description:
**Job Summary**

HealthSy Pharmacy is seeking a highly professional, detail-oriented **Retail Pharmacist** to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for accurately dispensing prescription medications, counseling patients on proper pharmaceutical usage and potential side effects, managing store inventory efficiently, and ensuring full compliance with healthcare regulations to deliver an exceptional patient-care experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Prescription Handling & Dispensing:** Process prescriptions accurately, ensure safe dispensing of medicines, and guide customers on dosage and medication usage.
* **Patient Counseling:** Educate customers on medication usage, potential side effects, drug interactions, and appropriate therapeutic alternatives.
* **Customer Handling:** Provide exceptional service by greeting walk-in customers, addressing their healthcare inquiries, resolving grievances, and maintaining a welcoming store environment.
* **Stock Management:** Work closely with the SCM team to maintain appropriate stock levels and properly log all customer requests to support continuous stock availability.
* **Delivery Coordination:** Maintain delivery request records and follow up to ensure timely delivery of medicines.
* **Customer Support:** Handle inbound calls and customer queries related to medicines, prescriptions, and home delivery orders.
* **Customer Retention & Support:** Deliver complete customer care and support to ensure customer satisfaction and long-term retention.
* **Billing & Cash Handling:** Support counter billing and cash transactions whenever required.
* **Storage & Safety:** Ensure proper storage of medicines, including temperature-sensitive products, and maintain stock security.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Follow applicable pharmacy regulations, licensing requirements, and HealthSy operational policies.
* **SOP & Policy Adherence:** Comply strictly with standard operating procedures (SOPs) and company policy for sheet handling, billing software usage, and transaction processing.
* **Inventory Verification & Inward Checks:** Perform thorough inward stock inspections by checking quantities, MRP, batch numbers, and expiry dates before updating stock entries in the system.
* **Regular Stock Audits & Expiry Monitoring:** Conduct bi-weekly physical stock counts across product categories, verify fast-moving items daily, and track product expiration to segregate near-expiry items and minimize stock wastage.

**Qualifications & Requirements:**

* B.Pharm / D.Pharm qualification.
* Valid State Pharmacy Council registration.
* 0–6 years of pharmacy experience (freshers can apply).
* Prior experience in a retail pharmacy setting is strongly preferred.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and customer-handling skills.
* Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced retail pharmacy setting and oversee daily operations efficiently.
* Customer-centric mindset paired with exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

**What you will get:**

* Competitive salary aligned with industry standards.
* Opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, dynamic healthcare organization.
* Performance-linked incentives as per company policy.
* Statutory benefits including PF and ESI compliance.
* Career development pathways and continuous learning opportunities.

title: Cyber - Data Protection- Databricks Security - Senior Consultant
description:
Join Deloitte Cyber's Data and Digital Trust practice as a Senior Engineering Management Specialist and help clients secure Databricks Lakehouse environments. You will assess security posture, implement governance and access controls, and integrate security capabilities across cloud data platforms. You will collaborate with client, delivery, and vendor teams to deliver practical solutions that support privacy, regulatory, and business objectives.

**Work you'll do**

As a Senior Engineering Management Specialist on the Data and Digital Trust team, you will be responsible for:

* Assess Databricks Lakehouse environments, including workspaces, Unity Catalog, clusters, SQL warehouses, notebooks, jobs, and data pipelines; identify security and regulatory gaps; and prioritize remediation.
* Design and implement data governance and access-control models using Unity Catalog, including metastores, catalogs, schemas, grants, row filters, column masks, and attribute-based access controls.
* Configure platform, network, and identity controls, including private connectivity, secure cluster connectivity, Internet Protocol (IP) access lists, cluster policies, secrets management, customer-managed encryption keys, single sign-on (SSO), System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) provisioning, and least-privilege access.
* Implement data classification, tagging, lineage, masking, tokenization, Delta Sharing, clean rooms, and cross-cloud or cross-workspace access for sensitive data.
* Enable audit logging and monitoring; integrate Databricks with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response (SOAR), and cloud security tools; evaluate complementary governance tools; and create architecture and operational documentation with client, delivery, and vendor teams.

**The team**

Data and Digital Trust practice is primarily focused on helping our clients to utilize effective data while safeguarding privacy and security. D&DT solutions prioritize transparency, privacy, and the ethical use of data, assisting organizations in driving sustainable digital transformation. Our solutions assist organizations in meeting the shifting expectations of consumers and create unprecedented business opportunities. We help our clients to define their overall Data protection and Privacy strategy, design global pan-enterprise programs that focus on mitigating threats, evaluate their objectives, priorities, strengths and weaknesses and roll out large scale organizational changes to achieve goals. Our services capture work across advice, implement, and operate solutions. The Data and Digital Trust team delivers services to clients through following key areas:

* Privacy Governance & Compliance
* Data Protection & Compliance
* Digital Trust & Online Protection
* Risk & Controls Enablement
* Technology & Implementation

Our Data and Digital Trust solutions are designed to allow organizations to address requirements stemming from the ever-changing regulatory landscape, consumer expectations, and technological transformations and advancements.

**Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Pune / Chennai**

**Shift Timings: General shift**

We are seeking a Senior ServiceNow Administrator to support the implementation, configuration, and ongoing administration of our ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) applications. This role requires a self-directed professional who can work independently with minimal oversight, partner directly with business stakeholders to gather and finalize requirements, and translate those requirements into well-designed, properly implemented platform solutions. The ideal candidate combines deep technical ServiceNow expertise with strong business analysis and communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Requirements & Solution Design
* Serve as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders and the ServiceNow platform, leading discovery sessions to gather, document, and finalize business requirements for CSM and ITSM initiatives. Translate requirements into functional and technical designs, evaluating out-of-the-box capabilities versus configuration or customization needs, and recommend the most maintainable, upgrade-safe solution. Present design options and trade-offs to stakeholders and drive decisions to closure without requiring heavy oversight.
* Implementation & Configuration
* Configure and implement ServiceNow CSM and ITSM modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, Service Catalog, CMDB, and Case Management. Build and maintain business rules, client scripts, UI policies, UI actions, ACLs, workflows, Flow Designer flows, and scheduled jobs. Design and configure forms, views, lists, and related lists to support business processes. Configure and maintain Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Operational Level Agreements (OLAs), assignment rules, and escalation logic. Build and maintain notifications, email templates, and inbound/outbound email actions.
* CSM-Specific Administration
* Configure and maintain Case and Account/Contact/Consumer data models, Customer Service Portal, Agent Workspace configurations, and Advanced Work Assignment (AWA) rules. Support entitlement management, service contracts, and customer-facing knowledge and community features. Configure omni-channel routing and skills-based assignment for customer service agents.
* ITSM-Specific Administration
* Administer the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), including CI classes, relationships, identification/reconciliation rules, and data integrity. Maintain ITSM process workflows (Incident, Problem, Change, Release) in alignment with ITIL best practices. Configure and support the Service Catalog, record producers, and catalog for client scripts/UI policies. Support Change Management processes including risk assessment, approval workflows, and change calendars.
* Platform Administration
* Manage user administration, roles, groups, and ACL security models. Perform system configuration tasks such as choice list, table, and dictionary management. Manage integrations via REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server, Integration Hub/Flow Designer, and LDAP/SSO configurations. Support platform upgrades, including testing, patch management, and pre/post-upgrade validation. Monitor system health, performance, scheduled jobs, and system logs; troubleshoot and resolve platform issues. Maintain update sets, manage promotion of changes across development, test, and production instances, and enforce change control/governance best practices. Support data imports/exports, transform maps, and data quality initiatives. Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and performance analytics for CSM and ITSM stakeholders.
* Governance & Continuous Improvement
* Maintain platform documentation, including configuration guides, process flows, and knowledge articles. Identify opportunities to optimize existing configurations and reduce technical debt. Stay current on ServiceNow releases, new features, and best practices, and recommend adoption where beneficial. Partner with the ServiceNow Customer Success Manager and vendor support as needed for platform issues and roadmap planning.

**Required Qualifications**

•     10+ years of hands-on ServiceNow administration experience, including direct experience with both CSM and ITSM applications.

•     Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal direction — gathering requirements directly from business stakeholders, designing solutions, and driving implementation to completion.

•     Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow platform architecture: business rules, client scripts, UI policies/actions, ACLs, Flow Designer, Workflow Editor, and Service Portal/Agent Workspace configuration.

•     Solid understanding of ITIL framework concepts (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management).

•     Experience with CMDB design and maintenance, including CI classes and relationships.

•     Experience configuring SLAs/OLAs, notifications, and approval workflows.      •     Proficiency with JavaScript, Glide APIs, and scripting within the ServiceNow platform.

•     Experience managing update sets and instance promotion across a multi-instance environment (dev/test/prod).

•     Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and vice versa.      •     ServiceNow System Administrator (CSA) certification required.

•     Experience with Out-of-the-Box (OOTB) integrations, Service Graph Connectors, and custom integrations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

•     ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in CSM and/or ITSM.      •     Experience with Integration Hub, REST/SOAP integrations, and MID Server configuration.

•     Experience supporting ServiceNow in a financial services, lending, or credit union technology environment.

•     Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies.

•     Experience with Performance Analytics and reporting/dashboard design.

title: Senior Commercial Operations Associate, Chennai - India
description:
**Senior Sales Operations Associate**

**Location: Chennai** **Why Exasol? Why Now?**

At Exasol, we believe that speed is the key to turning data into impact. Our in-memory, massively parallel processing (MPP) database is one of the fastest in the world, built from the ground up for analytics at scale. We help financial institutions, retailers, governments, and defense organizations make better decisions faster, by turning complex data into actionable insights in seconds, not hours.

This is a pivotal moment for Exasol. As we double down on our growth in Germany and across Europe, we are building a commercial team that thrives on curiosity, grit, and action. And it starts with you, our next Business Development Representative.

**Importance of the Role**

**Why this role matters**

Exasol is strengthening its commercial execution as it expands its position in enterprise software, data and AI. Commercial Leadership and the CEO need a reliable operating view of what is happening across Sales, Solution Engineering, Partner Sales, Marketing and Product-Led Growth; where revenue is at risk; what evidence is missing; and which actions will improve execution.

The Senior Sales Operations Associate will help build and run this operating system. This is not a traditional reporting role. You will help orchestrate the commercial motion, turn data into decisions, prepare leadership for critical meetings and ensure that agreed actions are followed through.

**About the role**

You will be a strategic and operational partner to Commercial Leadership, the CEO Office and cross-functional business leaders. Your work will sit at the intersection of revenue operations, commercial analytics, GTM execution and applied AI.

You will help the organisation answer:

* Are we on track to deliver our commercial objectives?

* Which opportunities, accounts or partners require intervention?

* Is pipeline becoming qualified customer progress?

* Are we converting customer engagement, product usage and partner access into revenue?

* What decisions and actions are required this week?

You will work closely with Sales, Solution Engineering, Partner Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, BI and senior executives across Europe and India

**What you will own**

**Commercial operating cadence**

* Prepare weekly and bi-weekly briefs for leadership meetings with Sales, Partner Sales and Marketing.

* Maintain a clear view of commercial performance by motion, owner, source and evidence status.

* Highlight what changed, why it matters, what is missing and what action is recommended.

* Maintain the commercial decision and action log, including owners, due dates and expected evidence.

* Track completion of commitments and escalate overdue or blocked actions.

* Prepare monthly commercial reviews and leadership updates.

* Help ensure that leadership meetings focus on decisions, risks and next actions rather than status reporting.

**Revenue data and commercial intelligence**

* Help establish and maintain a governed commercial data model across Salesforce, Finance, BI, product usage, partner activity and Marketing signals.

* Reconcile revenue, pipeline, forecast and source-attribution data.

* Build and maintain views of current performance, expected outcomes, upside and risk.

* Identify data-quality issues such as stale opportunities, missing next steps, duplicate records, weak source attribution or inconsistent close dates.

* Make missing evidence visible rather than allowing unsupported assumptions to enter the forecast.

* Develop practical dashboards and operating views that support decisions without creating unnecessary reporting overhead.

**GTM orchestration**

* Support the execution of the company’s priority commercial growth motions.

* Track account plans, customer problems, champions, economic buyers, technical success criteria and decision dates.

* Support cross-functional reviews of strategic accounts and opportunities.

* Monitor partner performance across account access, enablement, pipeline quality, progression and next customer actions.

* Connect Marketing and product engagement activity to qualified leads, champions, referrals and commercial opportunities.

* Help identify where a motion should be accelerated, adjusted, deprioritised or stopped.

* Support effective handoffs between Marketing, Sales, Product, Partner Sales and Solution Engineering.

**AI-native sales operations**

* Use AI tools and agents to automate preparation, summarisation, analysis, risk detection and action tracking.

* Help develop AI-enabled workflows for leadership briefings, opportunity inspection, account analysis, partner performance, Marketing attribution and data quality.

* Use forward-looking signals such as champion strength, decision-maker access, multithreading, customer-confirmed next steps, proof progress, procurement movement and competitive risk.

* Ensure AI outputs are traceable to source data and clearly distinguish confirmed evidence from assumptions.

* Maintain appropriate human approval boundaries: AI may summarise, flag, score and recommend, but commercial decisions remain with accountable leaders.

* Continuously identify opportunities to reduce manual preparation and improve the quality and speed of GTM execution.

**Commercial problem solving**

* Turn ambiguous commercial questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations.

* Support account, pipeline, partner and forecast reviews with concise, decision-ready materials.

* Investigate why opportunities are progressing, stalling or being lost.

* Work with Sales, Product, Engineering and Marketing to remove cross-functional blockers.

* Help translate customer and market signals into practical changes to the commercial motion.

* Challenge unsupported optimism constructively and help owners define the next measurable action.

**What success looks like in the first 6-12 months**

* Commercial Leadership and the CEO receive a reliable, concise and decision-ready view of the business.

* Revenue data, pipeline views and management reports reconcile to agreed definitions and sources.

* Sales, Partner Sales and Marketing meetings consistently result in clear actions, owners and dates.

* Priority commercial motions are visible separately, with named owners, evidence and risks.

* Commercial leaders spend less time preparing reports and more time making decisions and coaching teams.

* Data-quality issues are identified early and resolved by the accountable owner.

* AI-enabled workflows are actively used to improve preparation, opportunity inspection and action follow-through.

* The role becomes a trusted partner to Commercial Leadership, the CEO Office and cross-functional business leaders.

* The organisation has better visibility into which activities create qualified access, customer progress and revenue

✅ **What You’ll Bring (Must-Haves)**

* Strong2-5 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Strategy and Operations, Business Analytics, Management Consulting or a similar role.

* Strong business judgment and the ability to connect data with commercial outcomes.

* Excellent structured-thinking and problem-solving skills.

* Experience working with CRM data, ideally Salesforce, and BI or reporting tools.

* Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills; SQL or data-modelling experience is highly valuable.

* The ability to create concise executive-ready analyses, presentations and written briefs.

* Strong understanding of sales pipeline, forecasting, opportunity qualification and GTM processes.

* High ownership and the ability to drive actions across teams without relying on formal authority.

* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Comfort working with senior executives and challenging assumptions respectfully.

* Genuine curiosity about AI and practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity, analysis or decision-making.

* Strong attention to detail without losing sight of the broader business objective.

* Willingness to work Germany business hours and collaborate closely with teams across Europe and India

**Bonus Points (Nice-to-Haves)**

* Experience in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, data platforms or AI.

* Experience with Salesforce, BI platforms, data warehouses or revenue intelligence tools.

* Experience building automated workflows or using LLMs, agents and APIs.

* Exposure to partner sales, product-led growth, customer expansion or international GTM motions.

* Experience working with Finance, Sales, Product and Marketing data together.

* Familiarity with qualification frameworks, account planning or forecast governance.

**Who will thrive in this role**

You will thrive if you are data-centric but commercially minded; structured but pragmatic; comfortable withambiguity; and motivated by turning insight into action.

You should enjoy working close to senior leaders, asking difficult questions, finding the signal in imperfect data and helping teams execute with greater focus. You do not wait for perfect information or a fully defined task. You clarify the outcome, build a practical approach and take ownership of getting the work done.

**Deal-breakers**

* Treating Sales Operations as a passive reporting or data-entry function.

* Strong analytical ability without business judgment or commercial curiosity.

* Producing dashboards without clear decisions, actions or owners.

* Low attention to data quality or willingness to accept unsupported assumptions.

* Inability to operate with ambiguity, changing priorities and senior stakeholders.

* Limited interest in AI-enabled ways of working.

* Weak written communication or inability to explain complex findings clearly.

* Avoiding accountability for follow-through.

* Reluctance to work Germany business hours or from the Chennai office three days per week

**Ready to Launch Your Career with Exasol?**

**Why join Exasol**

This role offers broad exposure to Commercial Leadership, the CEO Office and senior business stakeholders while working on important company-wide growth priorities.

You will help shape how Exasol manages GTM execution, commercial intelligence and AI-enabled sales operations across Europe. The role combines strategy with real operating responsibility: you will not only analyse the business, but help the organisation decide where to focus, what to change and how to execute.

It is an opportunity to build deep experience across Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, business strategy, AI automation and international B2B software GTM.

**Our principles**

**About Exasol**

Take the next step in your career journey.

Exasol is a proud equal opportunities employer. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive working environment and therefore base all our employment selection decisions, within all aspects of our business, on experience, skill, and integrity. We strongly encourage applicants from all walks to life to apply for our positions, irrespective of age, sex, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, etc.

title: Engineer-NVH
description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

As a Engineer-NVH at Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd in the Automotive Division, you will be responsible for designing and developing Full Vehicle Level structural Finite Element (FE) models to analyse and enhance Noise, Vibration, and Harshness (NVH) performance. Your role will involve simulating and optimising vehicle structures to meet stringent NVH targets, thereby improving overall product quality and customer satisfaction.

Your key responsibilities will include:

* Building and refining FE models for full vehicle and sub-assembly structures, ensuring accuracy and reliability in simulation results.
* Collecting and integrating diverse structural system inputs to develop comprehensive FE models that support Drive Validation Packages (DVPs) with respect to global and local normal modes, driving point dynamic stiffness, Vibrational Transfer Function (VTF), and Noise Transfer Function (NTF).
* Developing detailed meshing guidelines to ensure consistency in model preparation, promoting best practices across projects and teams.
* Collaborating closely with multidisciplinary design teams to propose engineering solutions, validate designs, and implement structural enhancements that meet NVH performance goals.
* Performing detailed analysis to identify improvement areas within vehicle structures, including root cause investigations and providing actionable recommendations.
* Participating in design reviews, providing technical expertise to support product development milestones.
* Maintaining comprehensive documentation of simulation procedures, results, and recommendations to facilitate knowledge sharing within the organisation.

By fulfilling these deliverables, you will play a critical role in advancing Mahindra & Mahindra’s commitment to producing vehicles that excel in ride comfort and noise mitigation, directly contributing to enhanced customer experience.

**Experience**
--------------

The ideal candidate will possess between 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in NVH analysis and vehicle structural simulations, specifically using Finite Element Analysis (FEA) tools. Experience within the automotive industry is highly desirable, with a proven track record of working on full vehicle and subsystem-level NVH projects.

Proficiency in handling complex structural FE models, including familiarity with DVP-related analyses such as modal analysis, dynamic stiffness, Vibrational Transfer Functions, and Noise Transfer Functions is essential. Candidates should be adept at working with meshing techniques, creating and following guidelines that optimise model quality and computational efficiency.

Strong collaboration skills and experience working cross-functionally with design and product development teams are necessary to effectively translate NVH requirements into practical engineering solutions.

Experience with simulation software such as ANSYS, Abaqus, or equivalent is expected, along with a solid understanding of vehicle dynamics and structural behaviour related to noise and vibration phenomena.

Previous exposure to automotive NVH validation methods, as well as knowledge of regulatory standards related to vehicle noise and vibration, will be considered advantageous.

**Industry Preferred**
----------------------

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in the automotive sector, particularly those who have contributed to NVH engineering within major vehicle manufacturers or suppliers specialising in structural analysis and vehicle acoustics.

Relevant industry backgrounds include:

* Automotive OEMs engaged in vehicle design and development
* Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers focusing on automotive structural components and NVH solutions
* Engineering consultancies specialised in automotive noise and vibration analysis
* Research organisations involved in vehicle dynamics and acoustics

Working in a cutting-edge product development environment within the automotive division is preferred to ensure familiarity with industry processes, standards, and customer expectations related to vehicle NVH performance.

**Qualifications**
------------------

Candidates must hold a Bachelor of Engineering (BE) or Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a closely related discipline. A strong academic foundation in mechanics, materials, vibrations, and computational methods is essential for success in this role.

Additional certifications or training in Finite Element Analysis, NVH engineering, or relevant simulation tools will be considered a valuable asset.

Continuous learning and professional development in the latest NVH technologies and simulation techniques is encouraged to maintain technical excellence.

**General Requirements**
------------------------

We are seeking candidates who demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to continuous improvement and innovation. Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, are essential to liaise efficiently with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

The position requires individuals who can work independently as well as collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams, adapting to the dynamic demands of automotive product development.

Attention to detail, organisational capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple tasks within project timelines are critical for success.

No travel is required for this role, allowing for a focused work environment primarily based at our Chennai NVH department.

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
------------------------------------------------------

At Mahindra & Mahindra Limited, our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) is fundamental to our success as an innovative and socially responsible company. We embrace the unique experiences, perspectives, and talents of individuals from all walks of life to foster a workplace culture that is open, respectful, and empowering.

We believe that fostering diversity nurtures creativity and drives problem-solving excellence, enabling us to develop products that better serve a diverse customer base.

We implement inclusive hiring practices that do not discriminate based on age, caste, race, religion, colour, ethnic origin, gender identity, nationality, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, educational background, marital or domestic partnership status, pregnancy or childbirth, veteran status, citizenship status, ancestry, financial status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

* **Patching & Lifecycle:** Windows Update/WSUS/SCCM (if applicable), maintenance windows, rollback planning, change management.

* **Troubleshooting:** Performance counters, resource bottleneck analysis (CPU/memory/disk/network), boot issues, BSOD/log analysis, service failures, connectivity, name resolution issues.

* **Availability:** Designing for resilience (redundancy, failover concepts), handling planned/unplanned downtime, maintenance planning.

* **Remote Management:** RDP security, WinRM, PowerShell remoting, JEA/JIT concepts (nice to have).

* **Automation:** PowerShell scripting for administration, reporting, bulk operations; version control familiarity (Git) is a plus.

* **Documentation:** Build standards, operational runbooks, RCA reports, and system diagrams (text-based is acceptable).

Help push the boundaries of science to deliver life-changing medicines to patients. After 45 years in India, we’re continuing to secure a future where everyone can access affordable, sustainable, innovative healthcare.

Adapting and advancing our progress means constantly challenging the status quo. In this dynamic environment where everything we do has urgency and focus, you'll have the ability to show up, speak up and confidently take smart risks.

Your unique perspectives make our ambitions and capabilities possible. Our culture of sharing ideas, learning and improving together helps us consistently set the bar higher. As a proactive collaborator, you'll seek out ways to bring people together to achieve their best.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

**Job ID** R-263606 **Date posted** 11/06/2026

**Title: Analyst - Campaign Operations Analyst, Salesforce MCA and Adobe Campaign**

**Career Level: C3**

**About AstraZeneca**
---------------------

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.

**Introduction to role:**

Are you ready to turn marketing automation into measurable impact for patients and company outcomes? In the position of Campaign Operations Analyst located in Chennai, you will be responsible for managing multi-channel campaigns using the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform and Adobe Campaign. These campaigns help our medicines and programs reach the people who need them most. Your work will translate strategy into timely, relevant, and compliant communications that support brand objectives and patient outcomes.

You will join a collaborative, fast-moving team that brings marketers, data specialists, and technologists together to deliver at scale. Can you see yourself translating sophisticated requirements into detailed, multi-channel journeys at pace? Here, your expertise in building, testing, and optimizing campaigns will drive outcomes that matter—speed to market, engagement quality, and operational excellence.

**Accountabilities:**

* Campaign Build and Execution: Configure, build, test, and deliver emails, journeys, Cloud Pages, SMS, push notifications, and workflows across Adobe Campaign and the marketing cloud environment provided by Salesforce to meet defined business goals.
* End-to-End Delivery Ownership: Own campaigns from requirements capturing through QA, deployment, monitoring, and post-launch validation, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and impact.
* Collaborate with IT and data teams to enable clean, reliable data flows and integrations from multiple sources. Apply schemas, supplementary data structures, and governance principles to ensure audiences remain accurate and compliant.
* Personalization and Targeting: Implement segmentation, multifaceted content, tailored strategies, classification systems, and targeting logic that increase relevance and performance across channels.
* Quality, Compliance, and Governance: Follow SOPs, SLAs, change control, and access standards; uphold privacy, consent, suppression, and preference management to protect customers and the business.
* Fix and Continuous Improvement: Diagnose and resolve workflow, delivery, journey, automation, and data issues; escalate appropriately and foster insights into platform and process improvements.
* Collaborator Partnership: Translate requirements from business partners into robust technical solutions; communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to diverse collaborators across regions.
* Reusable Assets and Scalability: Build and maintain templates, workflows, automations, and standard configurations that improve consistency, speed, and scale across markets.
* Measurement and Optimization: Supervise campaign health and delivery; validate audiences and outcomes, and recommend enhancements that boost efficiency, data quality, and engagement over time.

**Crucial Skills/Experience:**
------------------------------

* 4-6 years of overall experience in marketing automation with SFMC, covering modules such as Email Studio and Journey Builder, Interaction Studio, Einstein, Automation Studio, and Adobe Campaign.
* Hands-on experience with Adobe Campaign and/or the Salesforce digital marketing platform in a campaign operations or marketing automation environment.
* Practical knowledge of Adobe Campaign workflows, deliveries, targeting, segmentation, personalization, typologies, and schemas.
* Knowledge of SFMC capabilities including Email Studio, Journey Builder, Automation Studio, CloudPages, Data Extensions, and audience segmentation.
* Solid understanding of SQL; exposure to AMPscript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, JSON, SOQL, APIs, and platform integrations is advantageous.
* Good understanding of campaign lifecycle management, data quality, audience segmentation, personalization, QA, and deployment processes.
* Understanding of data security, permission, blocking procedures, preference management, and access-control principles within marketing platforms.
* Strong analytical, solve, communication, and collaborator collaboration skills.
* Ability to work within established SOPs, SLAs, QA, change-management, and production deployment processes.
* Experience managing multiple campaign work in a fast-paced campaign operations environment while maintaining quality and timelines.

**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
--------------------------------

* Certifications in Marketing Cloud by Salesforce and/or Adobe Campaign.
* Sophisticated AMPscript and SSJS for personalization, CloudPages, and integrations.
* Experience with real-time and batch integrations using APIs, connectors, and event-based architectures.
* Knowledge of deliverability best practices, tracking, and testing tools across email and mobile channels.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, backlog management, and version control for campaign assets.
* Experience in regulated industries and with regional data privacy requirements.

**Why AstraZeneca:**

Join a mission-driven company where technology, data, and science come together to improve lives. You will work alongside marketers, engineers, and scientists who collaborate closely to solve complex challenges, often bringing unexpected teams into the same room to unlock bold thinking. We move with urgency, invest in modern platforms, and empower people to take smart risks while valuing kindness alongside ambition. Your contribution will help shape how we inform, educate, and support patients and healthcare professionals around the world, with the tools and mentorship to keep growing your craft.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

title: Systems Integration Senior Specialist
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Integration Senior Specialist to join our team in Chennai, Tamil Nādu (IN-TN), India (IN).
  
  
Patch Management Software Deployment is a senior hands-on technical role within NTT DATA's Enterprise Endpoint Management (EPM) practice. This individual owns the design, execution, and continuous improvement of enterprise patch management and software deployment operations across Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) and Microsoft Intune for one or more enterprise client accounts.
  
  
At Grade 9, the engineer operates with a high degree of independence on complex patching and deployment challenges, serves as the L3 escalation point for patch and software deployment issues within the team, and actively contributes to process governance, automation, and junior team development. The role is critical to client patch compliance posture, vulnerability remediation SLA adherence, and software lifecycle discipline across large, diverse endpoint estates.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Patch Management – SCCM / MECM
  

* Design and govern the end-to-end software update management lifecycle in SCCM — from SUP synchronisation through ADR execution, deployment targeting, and compliance reporting.
* Architect and maintain WSUS topology — upstream/downstream server configuration, product and classification scoping, synchronisation schedules, and cleanup routines.
* Build and manage Automatic Deployment Rules (ADRs) for Patch Tuesday, out-of-band, and zero-day update scenarios across tiered deployment ring strategies.
* Define and enforce maintenance window frameworks across server, workstation, and critical asset device collections aligned to client change management policies.
* Manage phased patch deployment pipelines — Pilot, UAT, and Production ring progressions with dwell periods and compliance gates.
* Monitor patch compliance dashboards and produce client-facing SLA compliance reports; drive remediation for non-compliant devices.
* Govern Software Update Point (SUP) health — synchronisation failures, WSUS certificate management, expired update cleanup, and IIS health monitoring.
* Manage third-party patch management integration within SCCM where applicable — SCUP, or third-party update catalogue publishing.
* Lead post-patch validation activities — confirming deployment success, identifying failed devices, and driving re-deployment or manual remediation workflows.

Patch Management – Microsoft Intune / Windows Update for Business
  

* Design and manage Windows Update for Business (WUfB) update ring policies in Intune for Quality Updates, Feature Updates, and driver update management.
* Configure and maintain Feature Update policies and Windows 11 readiness targeting for Intune-managed device populations.
* Govern Intune update compliance reporting — identify deferred, failed, and non-compliant devices and drive resolution within SLA.
* Manage Expedite Update workflows in Intune for emergency/zero-day patch scenarios requiring accelerated deployment.
* Align Intune update ring configurations with SCCM co-management patch workload authority assignments to prevent policy conflicts.
* Support Windows Autopatch readiness assessment and onboarding activities for eligible client environments.

Software Deployment – SCCM / MECM
  

* Lead application and software deployment design in SCCM — MSI, MSIX, EXE, and script-based deployments with accurate detection rules, supersedence chains, and dependency modelling.
* Build and manage SCCM deployment types, requirement rules, and global conditions for complex multi-platform application targeting.
* Design and govern phased deployment pipelines for critical software rollouts — piloting, staged production expansion, and rollback capability.
* Manage SCCM application catalogue health, deployment monitoring, and failed deployment investigation across client device estates.
* Govern SCCM Distribution Point (DP) content management — content pre-staging, validation, redistribution, and bandwidth throttling for remote site deployments.
* Lead software lifecycle management within SCCM — application versioning, supersedence, retirement, and catalogue hygiene.
* Support Software Metering configuration for licence compliance monitoring and usage reporting.

Software Deployment – Microsoft Intune
  

* Build and manage Win32 application deployments in Intune — IntuneWinAppUtil packaging, detection rules, requirement rules, and dependency targeting.
* Manage LOB app, Microsoft Store for Business, and MSIX package deployments in Intune with appropriate assignment targeting.
* Govern app deployment monitoring and remediation — resolve installation failures, assignment conflicts, and detection rule mismatches.
* Manage Intune app supersedence and update workflows for deployed Win32 and LOB applications.
* Support PowerShell script and remediation deployment via Intune for configuration enforcement and break-fix automation.

Compliance Reporting Vulnerability Remediation
  

* Produce and maintain patch compliance dashboards in SCCM SSRS, Power BI, or equivalent reporting tooling for client account review.
* Integrate patch compliance data with vulnerability management outputs (Qualys, Tenable, Defender Vulnerability Management) to drive prioritised remediation workflows.
* Maintain SLA compliance tracking for patch deployment targets — Critical, High, Medium, and Low severity update timelines.
* Lead monthly patch reporting packs for client QSR (Quarterly Service Review) inputs and governance reporting.
* Identify systemic compliance failures — analyse root causes (hardware, connectivity, agent health, exclusions) and drive permanent fixes.

Automation Scripting
  

* Develop and maintain PowerShell automation for SCCM patch operations — ADR management, collection membership, compliance queries, and remediation scripts.
* Build Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune patch compliance reporting, update ring management, and bulk device operations.
* Automate WSUS maintenance routines — expired update decline, computer cleanup, and synchronisation health monitoring.
* Create PowerShell-based deployment health check scripts for post-patch and post-deployment validation.

Documentation, Governance Mentoring
  

* Author and maintain patch management SOPs, runbooks, deployment playbooks, and maintenance window calendars.
* Represent patch and deployment changes in the client CAB (Change Advisory Board) process — RFC preparation and impact assessment.
* Provide L3 technical guidance and mentoring to Grade 7 and Grade 8 engineers on patch and software deployment operations.
* Conduct peer reviews of deployment configurations, ADR setups, and compliance reporting produced by junior team members.
* Contribute to EPM practice knowledge base, lessons learned documentation, and internal technical communities.

Required Skills
  
  
SCCM / MECM – Patch Deployment
  

* SCCM Current Branch – Software Update Management: SUP, WSUS, ADR, Maintenance Windows, Phased Deployments (advanced level)
* Application deployment – MSI/MSIX/EXE, detection rules, supersedence, dependency modelling, phased rollout
* Distribution Point management – content prestaging, bandwidth throttling, remote DP operations
* SCCM reporting – SSRS built-in reports, custom compliance queries, WQL collection queries
* Third-party patch integration – SCUP or third-party catalogue publishing experience (desirable)
* Co-management – patch workload authority, Intune/SCCM policy conflict avoidance

Microsoft Intune – Patch Deployment
  

* Windows Update for Business (WUfB) – update rings, Feature Update policies, driver management, expedite workflows
* Win32 app packaging and deployment – IntuneWinAppUtil, detection rules, requirement rules, dependency
* Intune compliance and update reporting – built-in reports, Graph API-based custom reporting
* Remediation scripts and PowerShell deployment via Intune
* Intune co-management alignment – patch workload and policy authority coordination with SCCM

Vulnerability Compliance Integration
  

* Integration of patch compliance with vulnerability management tools – Qualys VMDR, Tenable, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management
* SLA-based patch compliance tracking and executive reporting
* Power BI or SSRS for patch compliance dashboard development

Scripting Automation
  

* PowerShell – advanced scripting for SCCM patch operations, WSUS maintenance, Intune automation
* Microsoft Graph API – Intune patch compliance, update ring management, bulk device operations
* WMI/CIM – SCCM device collection queries, patch state interrogation

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) – held or in progress
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
* ITIL v4 Foundation
* Experience with Windows Autopatch assessment and onboarding
* Familiarity with SCCM CMG (Cloud Management Gateway) for internet-based patch management
* Exposure to Qualys VMDR, Tenable.io, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management integration with SCCM/Intune
* Prior experience delivering patch compliance in regulated environments — ISO 27001, HIPAA, SOX, or PCI-DSS

Experience Profile
  
  

* 9–12 years of progressive experience in enterprise endpoint management.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on SCCM/MECM Software Update Management and application deployment experience.
* Minimum 2 years of Microsoft Intune WUfB and Win32 application deployment experience.
* Proven track record managing patch compliance across multi-site enterprise estates of 5,000+ endpoints.
* Experience working in managed services, IT outsourcing, or large enterprise IT delivery models preferred.

Minimum Education
  
  

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.
* MCA or equivalent postgraduate qualification considered with commensurate experience.

title: Technical Account Representative (TAM)
description:
**Oracle Database Consultant**

We are seeking Oracle Database professionals to provide 24x7 operational and advanced support for mission-critical customer environments. The role includes database administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, performance tuning, high availability, backup/recovery, patching, and incident resolution across Oracle Database platforms.

* Administer, monitor, maintain, patch, upgrade, and troubleshoot Oracle Database environments.
* Perform SQL, database, memory, and performance tuning; analyze AWR/ASH and resolve complex performance issues.
* Manage Oracle RAC, ASM, RMAN, Data Guard, Fast-Start Failover, backup/recovery, and disaster-recovery operations.
* Support Oracle GoldenGate, Exadata, multitenant databases (CDB/PDB), Enterprise Manager, and OCI-hosted databases where applicable.
* Conduct database health checks, capacity reviews, proactive risk identification, and operational reporting.
* Resolve incidents within SLA, lead technical escalations, document root causes, and maintain support runbooks.
* Work closely with customer IT teams, Oracle Support, Development, and internal SMEs to drive issues to closure.
* Support database security capabilities including TDE, Oracle Key Vault, Database Vault, wallets, and AVDF where required.
* Provide clear customer communication, technical status updates, and action plans during critical incidents.

**Desired profile:**

* **L3 DBA / SME:** 10+ years of experience with advanced expertise in Oracle Database, Exadata, RAC, ASM, Data Guard, GoldenGate, performance tuning, backup/recovery, and high-severity escalations.
* Experience with Oracle Database 11g, 12c, 18c, and 19c; OCI and Oracle Enterprise Manager experience is preferred.
* BE/BTech/MCA/MS or equivalent experience; Oracle OCA/OCP, OCI, or Autonomous Database certifications are desirable.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, customer-management, and escalation-management skills.
* Willingness to work in a 24x7 support model and travel to customer locations when required.

**Qualifications:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field. Oracle certifications (e.g., OCI , OCA, OCP) are preferred.
* Experience: 8-12 years of hands-on experience with Oracle cloud administration and support.
* Shift : 24\*7 Shift working from Client Site Chennai / Bangalore . No remote or WFH allowed.

**Personal Skills**

* Strong experience in service delivery and/or project management is required.
* Oracle products and services knowledge will be highly appreciated as well as experience in Oracle HW platforms and OS.
* Experience on Enterprise Customers is required
* Excellent communication / relationship building skills
* Customer focused and results oriented
* Ability to work under pressure in highly escalated situations
* Organized with strong attention to detail
* Decision making / problem solving skills
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent activities (customer engagements)
* Highly professional: Ability to deal with senior and exec stakeholders with confidence
* Strong analytic skills and ability to identify potential risks and issues

  

**Technical Skills for an L3 / Senior Database Administrator**

* Advanced Oracle Database administration, architecture, upgrades, and patching.
* Expert performance tuning using AWR, ASH, ADDM, execution plans, and SQL optimization.
* Administration and troubleshooting of Oracle RAC, ASM, and Data Guard.
* Oracle GoldenGate (GG) configuration, replication monitoring, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Advanced RMAN backup and recovery, including point-in-time recovery and recovery validation.
* Database security, including Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), Oracle Database Vault, access controls, privilege management, and security hardening.
* Oracle Audit Vault and Database Firewall (AVDF) deployment, configuration, audit collection, monitoring, and policy management.
* Ownership of complex production incidents, root cause analysis, and preventive actions.
* Planning and execution of database migrations and upgrades with minimal downtime.
* Capacity planning, storage optimization, and automation using SQL, PL/SQL, and Linux/Unix shell scripting.
* Disaster recovery planning, failover testing, and business continuity support.
Technical leadership, mentoring of L1/L2 teams, and review of database changes and operational procedures.  

* **AI & ML Skillset ( Good to have )**
* Python: The core programming language for AI and Machine Learning.
* Essential Libraries:
  + NumPy for numerical computation and array handling.
  + Pandas for data manipulation and analysis.
  + Matplotlib/Seaborn for data visualization.
* ML/DL Frameworks: Hands-on experience with:
  + Scikit-learn for traditional ML models.
  + TensorFlow/Keras or PyTorch for Deep Learning implementations.
* SQL: Proficiency in querying and retrieving data from databases.
* Git: Competence in version control for collaborative development.
* Familiarity with various neural network architectures (CNNs, RNNs, Transformers).
* Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and generative AI principles.
* Big Data Tools: Exposure to platforms like Spark or cloud services for handling large datasets.

  **Responsibilities**
* Develop and Manage the Oracle Customer Relationships by forming long term customer relationships with key customer contacts. Work is non-routine and complex, involving the application of advanced technical/business skills in area of specialization. Provides direction and mentoring to more junior team members. Understand customer’s industry drivers, organization structure and key stakeholders, key projects and goals, and critical success factors as well as technical infrastructure and roadmap.
* Work collaboratively with sales, the delivery teams and customers to identify appropriate solutions.
* Coordinate delivery of Oracle Services, operating as the primary delivery contact to the customer, aiding and facilitating customer communications and activities across other Oracle lines of business.
* Responsible for delivering to the contracted terms, effective and efficient use of Oracle delivery resources, achieving the contract margin and revenue objectives.
* Identify and submit delivery leads for new opportunities and contract renewals.
* Act as a point of contact for any major incidents, responsible for managing communication and customer expectations through resolution.
* Establish and maintain a delivery governance model with the customer at the management and executive levels.
* Perform scope and risk management.
* Contribute to initiatives for Oracle delivery organizational process improvement and tool development.
* Conduct periodic Service Account Planning and Account Reviews.
* Be the single point of contact within Oracle for the customer, acting as their advocate for the service you are responsible for delivering.
* The CSS TAM is a customer advocate and must demonstrate customer obsession by placing the client needs first.
* Provide technical guidance and be part of the customer calls/meeting on adoption of database technology
* Should possess strong technical skills on Database and DB products to advocate to customer the use cases and guide the customer and team of Oracle CSS Engineers through the lifecycle of Oracle Technology product adoption
* Manage the contract or delivery engagement as defined by ACS line management, including creating and maintaining accurate documentation
* Maintain the Oracle business systems to ensure systems are up to date with the correct/current information (resource assignment, timecards, rates, completion estimates, invoice details etc.) to ensure that services are delivered efficiently, invoices are generated in a timely manner and revenues are recognised promptly.
* Plan and deploy resources to ensure effective delivery within agreed budgetary constraints.
* Where appropriate create and maintain the ACS service delivery or project plan.
* Actively manage project forecast, identify risks and issues and opportunity for revenue collection (upside)

  **Accountabilities** :
* Proactively manage the contract delivery to completion / customer acceptance
* Proactively report on any potential risks / issues that may impact service delivery or customer satisfaction
* Manage any customer escalation that may arise
* Ensure all contract-related systems and documentation either required contractually or as part of a program, are up to date and accurate
* Monitor and report revenue forecast and margin estimates, revenue and margin achievements for each contract
* Work in line with customer working practices and procedures, if contractually agreed
* Operate in line with Oracle CSS business processes and procedures
* Operate in line with Oracle Global and local HR policies and procedures

**Job Title/****Role:** Boomi Integration Engineer

**About Us**

Access is a global leader in information management solutions, offering comprehensive services across the entire document and records management lifecycle. From secure offsite storage for paper and digital records to advanced software for privacy, retention, and document management, Access enables organizations to protect, govern, and maximize the value of their information. Our end-to-end services include backfile imaging and digital delivery, scanning and digitization, business process automation, and secure destruction, purges, shredding and data archiving.

**About the Role**

The Boomi Integration Engineer designs, builds, and maintains integrations across Access's core enterprise systems using the **Boomi platform, connecting SQL Server** **(Mandate****)**, (Nice to have) - NetSuite, Salesforce, ADP, and other applications. This role owns the Boomi processes, connectors, and runtime environments that keep data accurate and systems reliable. It also supports Access's AI initiatives by building integrations that connect AI services with enterprise applications. The ideal candidate is a hands-on Boomi developer who can quickly understand, troubleshoot, and enhance existing integrations using documentation and execution logs.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**1.** **Boomi Integration** **Development and Support**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy integration processes in Boomi (AtomSphere), including connectors, maps, and process flows.

* Build and maintain integrations connecting **SQL** **Server** **(****SQL Coding** **- Mandate****)****,** (Nice to have)- NetSuite, Salesforce, ADP, and other enterprise systems.

* Perform data mapping, transformation, and workflow automation across systems, including mapping data to and from Tamr, a master data management (MDM) platform.

* Monitor processes and executions, troubleshoot failures, conduct root-cause analysis, and resolve issues to maintain data accuracy and system reliability.

* Review documentation and execution logs to understand existing integrations, debug issues, and implement enhancements.

* Support Boomi Atom and Molecule runtime environments, deployments, and environment promotion in accordance with team standards.

* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to gather requirements and deliver integration solutions.

* Participate in integration testing and validation.

* Maintain clear technical documentation for Boomi processes, integrations, and data flows.

* Follow integration best practices, security standards, and data governance policies.

**2. AI Integration Support**

* Own Boomi Connect, the managed Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector service, including configuring, maintaining, and monitoring the connectors through which AI platforms access enterprise systems.

* Build and maintain Boomi and API-based integrations between AI services, such as ChatGPT Enterprise, Claude, and other large language model (LLM) APIs, and enterprise applications, including CRM, ERP, and data platforms.

* Develop reusable Boomi patterns for invoking AI services within integration processes.

* Manage and secure API keys, tokens, and credentials in accordance with enterprise security practices. Partner with security and architecture teams to ensure compliant handling of sensitive information, including personally identifiable information (PII) and financial data.

* Monitor AI-related integrations for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency, and document integration patterns and operational procedures.

* Collaborate with the AI Platform Administrator, who owns MCP configuration within AI platforms, AI governance, and usage reporting, as well as with IT and Enterprise Architecture (EA) application owners.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 3+ years of hands-on experience building and supporting integrations on the Boomi integration platform as a service (iPaaS).

* Hands-on experience with **REST and SOAP APIs, JSON, and XML.**

* Strong Boomi troubleshooting and debugging skills, including analyzing process execution logs, implementing error handling, and enhancing existing integrations using documentation and logs.

* Experience with SQL and relational databases, such as SQL Server.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Boomi certification, such as Associate Developer, Professional Developer, or **Professional API Management**.

* Experience managing Boomi Atom, Molecule, and Runtime Cluster environments, and working with Boomi API Management, including API Gateway.

* Familiarity with Boomi Connect or other managed MCP connector services.

* Experience integrating with Salesforce or NetSuite.

* Experience with MDM platforms, preferably Tamr, particularly in data mapping.

* Experience with HRIS or financial systems, such as ADP, Concur, or Basware.

* Familiarity with authentication methods, including OAuth, API keys, and single sign-on (SSO).

* Understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability in integration platforms.

* Familiarity with secrets management tools, such as Azure Key Vault or AWS Secrets Manager.

* Exposure to AI/LLM platforms or APIs, such as OpenAI, Claude, or Azure OpenAI, or a willingness to learn.

* Experience with other iPaaS platforms, such as MuleSoft or Workato, is a plus.

**What** **You'll** **Gain**

* Hands-on experience with Boomi across business-critical enterprise systems.

* Exposure to modern AI platforms and real-world AI integration use cases.

* Opportunities to work with scalable API architectures and integration patterns.

**Competencies:**

* Analytical Thinking and Problem-Solving

* Ownership and Accountability

* Attention to Detail

* Communication and Stakeholder Collaboration

* Adaptability and Continuous Learning

title: Cloud Services Manager (Container)
description:
Req ID: 142267
  
Remote Position: Hybrid
  
Region: Asia
  
Country: India
  
State/Province: Chennai
  
City: Guindy, Chennai

**Summary**
-----------

Seeking an execution-focused, technically proficient **Manager of Cloud Services** to lead the day-to-day engineering and operations of our multi-cloud ecosystem across **AWS, Azure, and GCP**. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Cloud Architecture & Engineering, you will lead a dedicated squad of cloud, DevOps, and platform engineers tasked with translating high-level architecture designs into robust, production-grade deployments.

You will manage the implementation, maintenance, and reliability of our enterprise container platforms (GKE, AKS, OpenShift, and native Kubernetes), operationalize infrastructure for AI models and agentic workflows, and drive hands-on GitOps and IaC practices. This is an active, technical leadership role requiring direct participation in code reviews, pipeline automation, disaster recovery execution, and operational support.

**Detailed Description**
------------------------

Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:

* **Blueprint Execution:** Translate multi-cloud architectural frameworks into production-ready infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
* **Container Environment Provisioning:** Implement and standardize cluster topologies across Red Hat OpenShift, GKE, AKS, and upstream Kubernetes per architectural guidelines.
* **AI Runtime Infrastructure:** Deploy and support execution infrastructure for machine learning and agentic AI systems (e.g., configuring GPU/TPU nodes, model serving runtimes like vLLM/Triton, vector database clusters, and secure runtime sandboxes for agent execution).
* **IaC Authoring & Review:** Write, review, and maintain production Terraform modules, Helm charts, and raw Kubernetes/Kustomize manifests.
* **GitOps Delivery:** Manage and optimize automated GitOps pipelines using ArgoCD or Flux to ensure version-controlled, continuous deployments across staging and production clusters.
* **Internal Platform Enablement:** Maintain CI/CD pipelines, container registries, and self-service templates enabling software engineering and data science teams to deploy microservices smoothly.
* **Cluster Lifecycle Execution:** Coordinate and execute rolling cluster version upgrades, worker node pool patching, and OS maintenance across multi-cloud Kubernetes fleets with zero service disruption.
* **Capacity & FinOps Tracking:** Monitor resource consumption, configure cluster autoscalers (KEDA, Karpenter), implement pod resource quotas, and track daily compute costs across cloud providers.
* **Vulnerability & Compliance Remediation:** Enforce container base image hardening, automate CVE scanning (Trivy, Grype), and ensure runtime admission controllers (OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno) adhere to enterprise standards.
* **Backup Automation:** Implement, test, and manage automated backup routines for Kubernetes cluster states and persistent storage using tools such as Velero or Kasten.
* **Model & Artifact Protection:** Ensure secure, regular backups and snapshot validation for persistent AI datasets, model weights, and state stores.
* **Incident Management & Escalations:** Serve as an operational escalation point for L2/L3 production incidents, directing troubleshooting for container, network, and cloud outages.
* **Telemetry Operations:** Manage centralized logging, metrics, and tracing stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog), configuring actionable alerting rules and dashboards.
* **Root Cause Analysis (RCA):** Lead post-incident retrospectives, track action items to resolution, and implement self-healing automations to avoid recurrence.

**Knowledge/Skills/Competencies**
---------------------------------

* **Multi-Cloud Administration:** Hands-on operational experience with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (VPC/VNet configuration, IAM roles, cloud storage, security groups).
* **AI & Agentic Workload Enablement:** Practical experience deploying and managing infrastructure supporting AI/LLM workloads, containerized inference runtimes, or AI agent toolsets.
* **Infrastructure as Code & Templating:** Advanced proficiency writing and maintaining Terraform code, Helm charts, and native Kubernetes manifests.
* **GitOps & Automation:** Practical experience configuring and debugging GitOps tools (ArgoCD, Flux) and CI platforms (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
* **Observability:** Strong working knowledge of Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry collectors, and centralized log aggregation tools.
* Leadership**:** Proven track record of managing technical teams and delivering enterprise cloud infrastructure services.

**Physical Demands**
--------------------

* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.

**Typical Experience**
----------------------

* 7 to 10 years of relevant IT experience that shows consistent progression, and at least 5 years hands-on technology and team leadership experience.

**Typical Education**
---------------------

* Bachelor's Degree or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Educational requirements may vary by geography.
* Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

  + **Certifications:**

    - Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
    - Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration
    - Associate or Professional Cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect/SysOps, Azure Administrator, GCP Cloud Engineer)

Role : Academic Sales

Cinema Factory Academy is Chennai’s premier launchpad for the next generation of filmmaking, cinematography, direction,acting, editing, and media professionals. We bridge the gap between creative passion and industry reality. As the media and entertainment industry booms, our courses are in high demand—and we need a high-performing sales engine to turn passionate aspirants into enrolled students.

The Role

We are looking for a relentless, high-energy Inside Sales & Admissions Specialist who thrives on a target-driven environment. This is not a passive counseling role; this is a fast-paced sales position with target based from Day 1. Your primary mission is to convert inbound leads, handle walk-in inquiries, consult with aspiring artists/parents, and close admissions to hit our monthly batch targets.

If you are motivated by money, love the thrill of closing a deal, and want to sell something people are genuinely passionate about (Cinema!), this is your playground.

Consultative Closing: Guide aspiring students and their parents through the curriculum, handle objections smoothly, and create a sense of urgency to lock in admissions.

Pipeline Management: Maintain a clean, daily follow-up pipeline. Move leads aggressively through the funnel from initial contact to fee payment.

Hit Targets: Consistently meet or exceed weekly and monthly admission quotas set by the academy.

Walk-In Management: Host prospective students at our academy campus, giving them a compelling tour that builds value and drives immediate on-the-spot enrollment.

Communication Powerhouse: Flawless negotiation and persuasive communication skills in Tamil and English. You must know how to connect with young creatives as well as convince traditional parents.

Objection Handling: Ability to confidently handle price resistance, timing objections, and career anxieties to close the sale.

Resilience: A thick skin and a positive attitude. You treat a "No" as just a stepping stone to a "Yes."

Media Savvy (Plus): A general interest in cinema, media, or television is a massive advantage, as it helps you speak the students' language effortlessly.

Achieving Target From Day 1

Uncapped Incentives: A secure base salary paired with an aggressive, performance-linked incentive structure. The more admissions you close, the more you earn.

Dynamic Environment: Rub shoulders with filmmaking professionals, directors, and artists in a highly energetic academy atmosphere.

Front Office Administrator & Accounts Executive

**Department:** Administration & Customer Care  
**Industry:** Healthcare – Aesthetic Medicine & Pain Management  
**Location:** Saidapet, Chennai  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reports To:** Clinic Manager / Clinic Director

1. Job Summary

We are looking for a well-organised, professional, and patient-friendly Front Office Administrator with basic accounting knowledge to manage the daily front office operations, patient coordination, appointment scheduling, billing, and routine accounting activities of an aesthetic and pain management clinic.

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication and customer service skills, attention to detail, and the ability to maintain accurate financial and patient records while ensuring a smooth and professional patient experience.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Front Office & Patient Management

* Welcome patients and visitors professionally and ensure a positive patient experience.
* Manage incoming calls, WhatsApp enquiries, emails, and walk-in enquiries.
* Schedule, confirm, reschedule, and follow up on patient appointments.
* Coordinate consultations, aesthetic treatments, pain management procedures, and follow-up visits.
* Register new patients and update existing patient details in the clinic management system.
* Maintain patient files, consent forms, appointment records, and other relevant documentation.
* Explain consultation fees, treatment packages, and payment procedures to patients.
* Coordinate with doctors, nurses, therapists, and other clinical staff to ensure smooth patient flow.
* Handle patient queries and complaints professionally and escalate clinical concerns to the appropriate medical personnel.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with clinic policies and applicable healthcare regulations.

B. Billing & Cash Management

* Prepare patient bills, invoices, receipts, and payment acknowledgements.
* Generate accurate bills for consultations, aesthetic treatments, pain management services, and other procedures based on authorised price lists.
* Collect payments through cash, UPI, credit/debit cards, bank transfers, and other approved payment methods.
* Maintain daily cash collection and payment records.
* Reconcile daily collections against bills, receipts, and payment gateway or bank records.
* Track outstanding payments and follow up on pending dues.
* Maintain records of advance payments, treatment packages, discounts, refunds, and cancellations.
* Ensure all discounts, refunds, and billing adjustments are approved by the authorised person.
* Prepare daily collection reports and submit them to the management.

C. Basic Accounting & Bookkeeping

* Maintain day-to-day financial records using Excel, accounting software, or the clinic's designated system.
* Record daily income, expenses, receipts, and payments accurately.
* Enter and organise purchase invoices, expense vouchers, and other supporting financial documents.
* Maintain petty cash records and ensure proper documentation of all transactions.
* Assist in bank reconciliation and verification of payment transactions.
* Maintain records of vendor bills, supplier payments, and outstanding liabilities.
* Assist in tracking monthly operational expenses and preparing basic financial summaries.
* Coordinate with the external accountant or Chartered Accountant for bookkeeping, GST documentation, and other accounting requirements.
* Maintain organised records for internal audits, financial reviews, and statutory compliance.
* Ensure that all financial transactions are supported by appropriate documentation.

D. Administrative & Operational Responsibilities

* Maintain daily attendance records and coordinate staff schedules where required.
* Monitor stationery, front office supplies, and other administrative requirements.
* Assist in maintaining records of clinic purchases and service-related expenses.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers regarding invoices and payments.
* Ensure the reception area is clean, organised, and professionally maintained.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports as required by management.
* Assist the clinic manager with administrative tasks and operational coordination.
* Follow standard operating procedures for opening and closing the clinic.

E. Patient Follow-Up & Service Coordination

* Coordinate appointment reminders and follow-up visits.
* Maintain records of patient enquiries, consultations, and treatment bookings.
* Follow up with patients regarding scheduled appointments and outstanding payments.
* Coordinate treatment package bookings and session tracking.
* Assist in patient feedback collection and service-quality monitoring.
* Support patient retention and clinic service initiatives without making unauthorised medical claims or recommendations.

3. Qualifications & Experience

* Graduate in Nursing, Allied Medical Services, Administration, Accounting, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 1–3 years of experience in front office administration, billing, accounts, or customer service.
* Experience working in an aesthetic clinic, pain management clinic, hospital, polyclinic, or healthcare facility will be an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of accounting principles, bookkeeping, cash handling, and bank reconciliation.
* Familiarity with Tally, Zoho Books, or similar accounting software is desirable.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, email, and digital payment systems.
* Knowledge of GST invoicing and basic Indian accounting practices is preferred.

4. Required Skills & Competencies

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Professional, courteous, and patient-focused approach.
* Strong numerical ability and attention to detail.
* Good organisational and multitasking skills.
* Ability to maintain accurate financial and administrative records.
* Good problem-solving and time-management abilities.
* Ability to handle confidential patient and financial information responsibly.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with doctors, nurses, therapists, patients, and management.
* Integrity, accountability, punctuality, and a professional attitude.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on the following:

* **Appointment Management:** Accuracy of scheduling and minimisation of appointment-related errors.
* **Billing Accuracy:** Correct and timely generation of bills and receipts.
* **Daily Cash Reconciliation:** Accurate reconciliation and reporting of daily collections.
* **Accounting Records:** Timely and accurate maintenance of income, expenses, and supporting documents.
