Job Title: Linux Infrastructure Engineer

  
  

Location: Chennai, TN.

  
  

Employment Type: Full-Time / Contract

  
  

About the Role

  
  

We are seeking an experienced Linux Infrastructure Engineer to design, build, and maintain our scalable computing environment. In this role, you will be responsible for the lifecycle management of our Linux-based systems, bare-metal servers, and cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate is heavily focused on automation, infrastructure as code (IaC), and ensuring high availability, security, and performance for critical applications.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

  
  

System Administration: Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise Linux distributions (Ubuntu, Red Hat/RHEL, SUSE, or CentOS) across bare-metal, virtualized, and cloud environments.

  
  

Automation & Configuration Management: Automate repetitive tasks and system provisioning using tools like Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.

  
  

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Design and deploy scalable infrastructure using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.

  
  

Cloud & Virtualization: Manage cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP or OCI) and on-premise virtualization platforms (VMware, KVM, Nutanix).

  
  

Containerization & Orchestration: Deploy, support, and scale containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes.

  
  

Monitoring & Reliability: Proactively monitor system performance, uptime, and capacity using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Zabbix. Lead incident response and perform root-cause analysis (RCA).

  
  

Security & Patch Management: Enforce security best practices, manage IAM/RBAC, apply kernel patches, configure firewalls (iptables/firewalld), and ensure compliance standards are met.

  
  

CI/CD Integration: Work closely with DevOps and software engineering teams to support continuous integration and deployment pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).

  
  

Required Qualifications

  
  

Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in Linux system administration and IT infrastructure engineering.

  
  

OS Expertise: Deep understanding of Linux internals, file systems (LVM, NFS, EXT4, XFS), kernel tuning, and package management.

  
  

Scripting Skills: Strong proficiency in writing automation scripts in Bash, Python, or Go.

  
  

Networking Knowledge: Solid grasp of core networking protocols and concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SSH, VPNs, Load Balancing, and routing).

  
  

Hardware/Storage: Experience managing bare-metal servers, SAN/NAS storage, and RAID configurations.

  
  

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

  
  

Industry certifications such as RHCE (Red Hat Certified Engineer), AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, or CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator).

  
  

Experience managing GPU-accelerated infrastructure or AI/ML computing platforms.

  
  

Familiarity with Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS) platforms.

  
  

Experience migrating legacy on-premise infrastructure to public cloud platforms.

title: SAP Basis Administrator
description:
We are looking for an experienced **SAP Basis Administrator** with strong hands-on expertise in SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA database administration, SAP system administration, and enterprise application support. The ideal candidate will be responsible for maintaining the stability, availability, performance, security, and reliability of SAP landscapes across development, quality assurance, and production environments.

The successful candidate will have proven experience in SAP Basis operations, system installations and upgrades, kernel maintenance, transport management, system refreshes, performance optimization, backup and recovery, and production incident resolution. Experience working in Application Management Services (AMS), ITIL-aligned operations, and SLA-driven support environments will be highly valued.

This role requires close collaboration with infrastructure, cloud, security, database, functional, and technical teams to ensure seamless SAP operations in a global, 24x7 support environment.

Key Responsibilities1. SAP Basis Administration and System Operations

* Administer, monitor, and maintain SAP S/4HANA, SAP HANA, and related SAP application landscapes.
* Perform daily system health checks, availability monitoring, background job monitoring, and proactive issue identification.
* Manage SAP system parameters, profiles, work processes, RFC destinations, system logs, and operational configurations.
* Support SAP application server administration and investigate system availability and connectivity issues.
* Ensure SAP environments remain stable, secure, and compliant with operational standards.

2. SAP Installation, Upgrades, and Maintenance

* Perform SAP installations, system copies, system refreshes, client copies, and post-refresh validation activities.
* Execute kernel upgrades, Support Package Stacks (SPS), and other planned maintenance activities.
* Support SAP software lifecycle management and maintenance using applicable SAP tools and procedures.
* Plan and execute technical maintenance activities in coordination with application, infrastructure, and project teams.
* Validate system functionality and stability following upgrades, patches, and maintenance windows.

3. SAP HANA Database Administration

* Monitor SAP HANA database health, resource utilization, alerts, and database performance.
* Support database backup, recovery, housekeeping, and capacity monitoring activities.
* Troubleshoot database connectivity, resource contention, and performance-related issues.
* Coordinate with database specialists to resolve complex database incidents and optimize system performance.
* Support backup validation, recovery readiness, and disaster recovery procedures.

4. Transport Management and Release Support

* Manage SAP Transport Management System (TMS) activities across development, quality assurance, and production environments.
* Import, monitor, and troubleshoot transport requests while ensuring adherence to release and change management procedures.
* Coordinate transport sequencing, dependency checks, and deployment validation with functional and technical teams.
* Support production releases, emergency transports, and scheduled deployment activities.
* Maintain appropriate transport documentation and audit trails.

5. Performance Monitoring and Troubleshooting

* Analyze SAP system performance using relevant SAP monitoring and diagnostic tools.
* Investigate short dumps, system logs, work process issues, failed background jobs, memory utilization, and system bottlenecks.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents, service disruptions, and performance degradation.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions to improve system reliability and operational efficiency.
* Escalate complex technical issues to the relevant SAP, database, infrastructure, or vendor support teams.

6. High Availability, Backup, and Disaster Recovery

* Support SAP high-availability (HA) configurations, disaster recovery (DR) readiness, and business continuity activities.
* Participate in backup monitoring, recovery testing, failover validation, and disaster recovery drills.
* Assist with SAP system restoration and recovery activities in accordance with approved procedures.
* Ensure operational documentation and recovery runbooks are current and accessible.

7. Monitoring, Incident, and SLA Management

* Support SAP monitoring through SAP Solution Manager and other applicable enterprise monitoring tools.
* Manage incidents, service requests, and problem records in accordance with established ITSM processes.
* Meet defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs), response times, resolution targets, and operational KPIs.
* Participate in major incident management, escalation handling, and post-incident reviews.
* Maintain accurate incident records, technical documentation, and knowledge base articles.

8. Security, Compliance, and Stakeholder Collaboration

* Perform Basis-related user administration and authorization support within approved access controls.
* Coordinate with SAP security teams for access-related troubleshooting and compliance requirements.
* Follow change management, configuration management, audit, and information security policies.
* Collaborate with functional consultants, ABAP developers, infrastructure teams, cloud operations, and business stakeholders.
* Participate in technical reviews, operational meetings, knowledge-sharing sessions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

9. Global Support and Shift Operations

* Provide production support in a 24x7 global operating model.
* Work in rotational shifts, including night shifts, weekends, and on-call support when required.
* Participate in planned maintenance windows, critical business support activities, and production deployment events.
* Ensure effective handovers between shifts and timely communication of critical issues.
* Maintain operational continuity and service quality across geographically distributed teams.

Required Technical Skills and Qualifications

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in SAP Basis administration and technical operations.
* Strong hands-on experience supporting SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Practical experience with SAP HANA database administration and monitoring.

title: Senior Mainframe ISPW Production Control Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.

  

**What You Will DO**

  

* Lead end-to-end ISPW Production Control activities, including build generation, promotions, approvals, release scheduling, controlled deployments, and post-implementation validation for standard, critical, and emergency changes.
* Serve as the senior technical escalation point for high-priority incidents and business-critical releases, driving issue resolution, root cause analysis, and implementation of preventive actions.
* Administer, support, and troubleshoot BMC AMI DevX Code Pipeline (formerly Compuware ISPW), including application configuration, streams, lifecycle levels, component types, deployment definitions, and related reference settings.
* Manage product upgrades, patching, maintenance, configuration changes, health checks, and resilience activities, while coordinating with BMC Support and Mainframe Infrastructure teams to ensure platform stability.
Provide operational and technical expertise for the phased modernization and replacement of ISPW Build & Deploy capabilities, including application inventory assessment, repository and lifecycle mapping, dependency analysis, migration readiness planning, and technical risk management.  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* Minimum 7+ years of hands-on experience in Mainframe Production Control, ISPW release management, deployment operations, and ISPW administration within enterprise z/OS environments.
* Strong expertise in BMC AMI DevX Code Pipeline (ISPW) including assignments, generates, promotions, approvals, releases, deployments, failure analysis, and post-implementation validation.
* Proven experience administering and troubleshooting ISPW configurations, including applications, streams, lifecycle levels, component types, deployment definitions, Technical Support Tables, Generate settings, and customizations.
* Solid knowledge of z/OS technologies including JCL, TSO/ISPF, datasets, batch processing, REXX, and working familiarity with COBOL, Db2, CICS, and IMS environments.
* Experience supporting critical production implementations, emergency changes, release recovery, technical escalations, and root cause analysis in business-critical environments.
* Working understanding of Mainframe security controls such as RACF, ACF2, or Top Secret, alongside governance, audit, and segregation-of-duty requirements.
Strong ITIL/ITSM expertise across incident, problem, change, and release management, including Sev-1 and Sev-2 production support responsibilities.  

  
  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Experience with modern DevOps and CI/CD platforms including Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, and pipeline automation frameworks.
* Knowledge of Mainframe modernization technologies such as Digital.ai Release (XLR), Zowe, z/OSMF, Ansible Automation Platform, and API-driven deployment solutions.
* Exposure to artifact repositories and quality tools including Artifactory, SonarQube, package management, and software release governance processes.
* Experience integrating enterprise identity and security solutions such as Vault, LDAP, IAM, RACF integration, approval workflows, and ServiceNow.
* Demonstrated ability to assess technical risks, maintain audit-ready deployment evidence, and drive operational excellence through automation and standardization.
Willingness to work in a hybrid model from Bengaluru or Chennai, including rotational shifts, weekend releases, and critical production support coverage as required.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:
POSITION DETAILS
  
**Job Title:** ManageEngine/Intune Lead Engineer – Enterprise Endpoint Management
  
**Location:** India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)

ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking an experienced ManageEngine/Intune Lead Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This lead-level role combines deep technical expertise with delivery ownership — driving complex ManageEngine/Intune engagements, leading technical teams, architecting enterprise endpoint solutions, and serving as a key client-facing technical authority for EPM workstreams from India. The Lead Engineer plays a critical role in NTT DATA's EPM service delivery quality, client satisfaction, and practice capability growth, supporting global accounts across the US, Europe, and APAC.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Technical Leadership Architecture
  

* Lead end-to-end design and implementation of enterprise ManageEngine/ConfigMgr and Microsoft Intune environments for global client accounts.
* Architect co-management strategies, Autopilot provisioning frameworks, and Modern Management transition roadmaps.
* Own the technical direction for SCCM-to-Intune migration engagements including workload transition planning, timeline development, and risk mitigation.
* Define EPM platform standards, governance frameworks, and configuration baselines across multiple global accounts managed from India.
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Manager capabilities and provide technical roadmap recommendations to delivery managers and clients.

Enterprise Patch Management
  

* Own enterprise-level patch management programs — governing policy, SLAs, exception management, and compliance reporting across 10,000+ endpoint fleets.
* Design and manage Intune Expedite policies, WUfB rings, and SCCM ADR-based patching for complex multi-site global environments.
* Lead vulnerability remediation programs integrating Qualys/Tenable findings with ManageEngine/Intune patch deployment cycles.
* Develop patching governance documentation, escalation playbooks, and compliance dashboards for client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead emergency and zero-day patching response including containment, deployment, and post-incident review from India delivery centre.

Advanced OS Deployment Provisioning
  

* Lead enterprise Windows 11 migration programs including readiness assessment, task sequence design, pilot execution, and phased rollout.
* Design and deliver Windows Autopilot + Intune Zero Touch Provisioning frameworks for large-scale global device refresh programs.
* Own OSD platform operations — WinPE environments, MDT integration, driver library management, and image currency.
* Architect golden image build pipelines, compliance validation, and automated post-deployment configuration.
* Define device lifecycle management policies from procurement through decommission for managed global client environments.

Automation Integration
  

* Architect PowerShell-based automation frameworks for and Intune operational efficiency and compliance reporting.
* Lead development of Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune bulk operations, automated policy SCCM enforcement, and reporting.
* Design SCCM SQL/Power BI reporting solutions for delivery management and client-level visibility into endpoint health and patch posture.
* Oversee integration between EPM platforms and security tooling (Qualys, Defender for Endpoint) for holistic endpoint health management.

Client Engagement Delivery Governance
  

* Serve as primary technical point of contact for assigned EPM accounts — leading governance calls, delivery reviews, and escalation resolution from India.
* Drive SLA attainment, delivery quality, and continuous improvement across managed global endpoint accounts.
* Contribute to SOW development, effort estimation, and technical proposal documentation for new and expanding EPM engagements.
* Mentor and develop Grade 7–9 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and structured capability building.
* Collaborate with NTT DATA India practice leadership and onshore counterparts on EPM service development and client strategies.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* ManageEngine Endpoint Management Tool (expert)
* Microsoft Intune — full MDM/MAM lifecycle, co-management, Autopilot, WUfB, Conditional Access (expert)
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — site architecture, hierarchy design, OSD, patch management, reporting (expert)
* Windows 10/11 enterprise deployment — task sequences, MDT, WinPE, driver management, ZTP Autopilot
* Azure AD / Entra ID — identity-driven EPM, Conditional Access, MFA, device trust, RBAC
* PowerShell advanced automation — SCCM SDK, Graph API, reporting pipelines, operational tooling
* SQL Server + Power BI — SCCM database reporting, compliance dashboards, management-level visualizations
* Vulnerability management — Qualys/Tenable integration with patch management lifecycle

title: Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune
description:
**Req ID:** 392090
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering SPECIALIST - SCCM/Intune to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
POSITION DETAILS
  
**Job Title:** SCCM/Intune Engineer – Endpoint Management
  
**Location:** India — Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai / Noida (Hybrid)
  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time (Permanent)
  
**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in enterprise endpoint management with demonstrated proficiency in both Microsoft Intune and ManageEngine, preferably in a managed services or IT outsourcing environment.
  
**Compensation:** Competitive CTC commensurate with experience. Benefits include health insurance (self and family), PF, gratuity, variable performance bonus, leave travel allowance (LTA), and professional certification support.
  
**Work Hours:** IST - aligned shifts; flexibility required for global client coverage
  
  
ROLE OVERVIEW
  
We are seeking a skilled SCCM/Intune Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This mid-level role involves independently managing end-to-end endpoint lifecycle operations. We are looking for a dedicated ManageEngine Patch Management Engineer to take full ownership of our endpoint security compliance and automated patching lifecycle. In this role, you will manage, configure, and maintain our deployment of ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus (or Endpoint Central patching modules). Your primary goal will be to secure our enterprise environment by systematically deploying OS updates and keeping third-party applications up to date to minimize our corporate vulnerability footprint.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
OS Deployment Image Management
  

* Design, build, and maintain Windows 10/11 OSD task sequences using SCCM/MDT integration for global client environments.
* Manage WinPE boot images, driver packages, and deployment boundaries for OSD operations.
* Support OS refresh, wipe-and-reload, and in-place upgrade deployment scenarios.
* Troubleshoot OSD failures including PXE boot issues, task sequence errors, and driver conflicts.
* Contribute to Windows Autopilot profile configuration and deployment for Intune-managed devices.
* Maintain image documentation including build standards, versioning, and patch currency records.

Patch Management
  

* Automated Patch Deployment (APD): Design, configure, and manage Patch Manager Plus workflows to automate the entire patching lifecycle—from vulnerability database synchronization to final deployment.
* Cross-Platform OS Management: Oversee scheduled and critical patching for a heterogeneous network environment encompassing Windows Endpoints.
* Third-Party Application Patching: Package, test, and push updates for an extensive catalog of supported third-party enterprise software (e.g., Adobe, Java, web browsers, and productivity suites).
* Test Approve Testing Ring Processes: Establish strict deployment policies using non-production test groups to verify patch stability before pushing updates into the production environment.
* Decline Exclude Rule Management: Review security advisories and selectively decline patches that cause known infrastructure conflicts or are incompatible with legacy enterprise software.
* Compliance Reporting: Utilize the Patch Manager dashboard to generate real-time compliance audits, vulnerability summaries, and endpoint patching health reports for executive leadership.

Application Software Management
  

* Manage complex application deployments using SCCM applications with detection methods, requirements, and dependencies.
* Package enterprise applications using .intunewin format and deploy via Intune with advanced targeting.
* Support software metering, asset intelligence, and license management activities in SCCM.
* Design and implement application supersedence and uninstall workflows.
* Collaborate with app packaging teams to validate and test packaged software before production deployment.

Infrastructure Platform Management
  

* Monitor and maintain SCCM site server health, DP replication, and component status for client environments.
* Manage Intune connector, certificate infrastructure, and Intune service health.
* Develop PowerShell scripts for endpoint automation, reporting, and operational efficiency improvements.
* Handle L2/L3 escalations with thorough root cause analysis and permanent fix documentation.
* Participate in change management, CAB reviews, and client operational governance calls during IST business hours.

REQUIRED SKILLS
  

* Microsoft Intune — device management, compliance, WUfB, Win32 app deployment, Autopilot
* ManageEngine — patch management
* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — OSD, applications, collections, and reporting (proficient)
* Windows 10/11 image management — task sequences, WinPE, driver management, MDT integration
* Azure AD and Hybrid Azure AD join configurations, conditional access, and co-management
* PowerShell scripting for automation, reporting, and endpoint remediation
* SQL/WQL queries for SCCM inventory and compliance reporting
* ITSM operations — incident, problem, and change management (ServiceNow or equivalent)
* Strong written and spoken English for client-facing delivery and documentation

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent
* Experience with SCCM-to-Intune co-management and workload migration
* Exposure to Qualys, Tenable, or vulnerability management integration with EPM
* Experience in NTT DATA, Infosys, Wipro, TCS, HCL, or similar IT outsourcing delivery models

MINIMUM EDUCATION
  
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent experience and industry certifications will be considered.

description:

Job Title: AS400 Admin/iSeries Support - Lead  
Position: SSE/LA  
Experience: 6-9 years  
Category: Infrastructure/Admin  
Positions open: 4  
Shift: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST  
Main location: Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad  
Position ID: J0926-1800  
Employment Type: Full Time  
Education Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or higher with minimum 06 years of relevant experience  
  
Job Summary  
Experience Required: 6–9+ Years  
  
Job Summary  
We are seeking a high caliber Senior AS/400 (IBM i) Systems Administrator / Infrastructure Engineer (L3 Support) to serve as the senior technical authority for our enterprise IBM Power Systems platform. In this lead engineering role, you will be responsible for platform architecture, operating system upgrades, virtualization design, deep tier incident forensics, high availability/disaster recovery (HA/DR) design, storage engineering, and performance optimization.  
The successful candidate will act as the final internal escalation tier for mission critical IBM i infrastructure incidents, drive complex OS migrations across releases (IBM i 7.3, 7.4, and 7.5), architect PowerVM and VIOS environments, optimize enterprise storage configurations (IASP, SAN integration), and orchestrate automated HA/DR replication architectures (PowerHA, MIMIX). This role focuses purely on system architecture, operating system engineering, security hardening, and infrastructure resilience, serving as the technical liaison to IBM Support (PMR/Escalations), enterprise architects, and executive IT management.  
  
  
Key Responsibilities  
1. Level 3 Escalation, Deep Diagnostics & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)  
  
. Serve as the supreme technical escalation authority for severe (P1/Major) system outages, abnormal IPLs, kernel exceptions, hung partitions, and machine check conditions.  
. Conduct advanced system crash investigations using System Service Tools (SST), Dedicated Service Tools (DST), Main Storage Dumps (MSD), and LIC trace analysis.  
. Interrogate advanced logs (PAL, QHST, Advanced Job Logs) to diagnose complex intermittent hardware faults, bus channel errors, and memory corruptions.  
. Own and author definitive Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation; engineer preventative architecture changes to permanently eliminate systemic failure modes.  
. Manage and drive complex technical support cases (PMRs / IBM Support Cases), coordinating directly with IBM Level 3 labs and Rochester development teams.  
  
2. Operating System Lifecycle, Version Migrations & PTF Engineering  
  
. Architect, plan, and execute major OS release upgrades (e.g., migrations from IBM i 7.3/7.4 to 7.5) and Technology Refresh (TR) cycles across large scale enterprise estates.  
. Formulate comprehensive PTF management policies; perform cross subsystem prerequisite/corequisite analysis, microcode/firmware compatibility matrices, and regression risk assessments.  
. Manage system level configurations including dynamic tuning system values, Workload Groups, Subsystem Descriptions (SBSD), Class parameters, and memory pool allocations.  
. Oversee system initialization scripts, startup programs (QSTRUP), subsystem routing architectures, and operational configurations.  
  
3. Power Systems Architecture, PowerVM & VIOS Engineering  
  
. Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise IBM Power Systems hardware (Power9, Power10) managed via redundant Hardware Management Consoles (HMC).  
. Design and implement PowerVM virtualization solutions, including Virtual I/O Server (VIOS) clustering, Shared Ethernet Adapter (SEA) failover, and N\_Port ID Virtualization (NPIV) SAN mapping.  
. Engineer enterprise LPAR topology, configuring shared processor pools, capped/uncapped partitions, Virtual Processors, and dynamic processor/memory optimization.  
. Lead HMC firmware lifecycles, service processor firmware upgrades, and disaster recovery replication for HMC configurations.  
  
4. Enterprise HA/DR Architecture & Disaster Recovery Orchestration  
  
. Design, implement, and fine tune enterprise High Availability (HA) replication architectures using solutions such as Precisely MIMIX, IBM PowerHA SystemMirror, or Maxava HA.  
. Architect journal environments: Remote Journaling (RJ), asynchronous/synchronous network transport, dual journal receivers, and threshold management.  
. Architect and lead scheduled enterprise Disaster Recovery (DR) and full role swap (switchover / failover) tests, guaranteeing stringent Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).  
. Develop and maintain automated failover scripts, audit validation procedures, and emergency split brain recovery playbooks.  
  
5. Storage Engineering, IASP & Resiliency Architecture  
  
. Architect auxiliary storage topologies, balancing internal NVMe/SAS drives and external SAN arrays (IBM FlashSystem, DS8000) using San Volume Controller (SVC).  
. Implement and manage Independent Auxiliary Storage Pools (IASP) to isolate databases for modular switchover and flash copy operations.  
. Formulate enterprise wide BRMS (Backup, Recovery, and Media Services) architecture, including network synced BRMS clusters, media lifecycle policies, and VTL encryption.  
. Author and validate bare metal disaster recovery procedures, cold start installation plans, and full scale recovery runs (SAVSYS / Option 21 rebuilds).  
  
6. Advanced Performance Tuning, Profiling & Capacity Planning  
  
. Conduct deep tier system performance profiling utilizing IBM i Performance Data Investigator (PDI), Collection Services, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, and IBM i Doctor.  
. Optimize system memory allocation by tuning dynamic system values (QPFRADJ), defining private memory pools, and resolving object lock contention.  
. Analyze disk subsystem bottlenecks, arm contention, queue depths, and optimize paging space allocation.  
. Formulate multi year capacity planning models predicting CPU (CPW), memory, and SAN storage expansion aligned with corporate business growth.  
  
7. Security Hardening, Audit Forensics & Compliance Architecture  
  
. Architect and enforce OS security hardening in accordance with IBM i Security Level 40 and 50 standards.  
. Establish comprehensive security auditing architectures via QAUDJRN, configuring journal filters for security critical actions and unauthorized object manipulation.  
. Implement adopted authority controls, secure system values (QSECURITY, QPWD\*, QALWUSRDMN), and service program access controls.  
. Drive compliance and vulnerability management programs (SOX, PCI DSS, ISO 27001), designing automated scripts to remediate non compliant configurations.  
  
8. Infrastructure Automation, Modernization & Technical Mentorship  
  
. Architect reusable operational automation utilizing advanced Control Language (CL) programs and modern Db2 for i / IBM i Services (QSYS2).  
. Evaluate and implement modern administration frameworks, such as IBM i open source integration (PASE, Bash, Python), Ansible for IBM i automation, and REST APIs.  
. Serve as the technical mentor and escalation lead for L1 and L2 system administrators, conducting peer technical reviews and establishing enterprise engineering standards.  
. Participate in architectural review boards (ARB) for major business applications and enterprise infrastructure projects.  
  
Key skills :  
Backup strategies, disaster  
Recovery plans  
Performance tuning,  
Capacity/resource planning  
Data Restoration  
System Upgrades  
  
  
Required Qualifications  
  
. Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent industry experience.  
. Experience: Minimum of 6–10+ years of dedicated, hands on enterprise experience in IBM i (AS/400) System Engineering, Power Systems Architecture, and L3 Support.  
. Environment Experience: Proven track record architecting and supporting large scale enterprise environments (30+ LPARs, multi system Power9/Power10 estates, petabyte scale storage, and critical transaction banking/retail/logistics systems).  
  
  
Required Technical Skills  
  
. Operating System Mastery: Deep internal architecture knowledge of IBM i (releases 7.2 through 7.5), LIC, SLIC, Microcode, Machine Check handling, and SST/DST forensics.  
. OS Migration & Lifecycle: Proven leadership in executing complex OS release upgrades (e.g., 7.3 > 7.4 > 7.5) and comprehensive Technology Refresh (TR) deployments.  
. Hardware & Virtualization: Advanced architecture experience with IBM Power9/Power10, redundant HMCs, PowerVM, dual VIOS configurations, NPIV, SEA, and dynamic LPAR allocation.  
. High Availability & DR: Mastery of enterprise HA solutions: MIMIX or PowerHA SystemMirror; comprehensive design of Remote Journals, data synchronization engines, and full site to site role swaps.  
. Storage & Resiliency: Architecture of IASP, SAN attached storage (SVC/FlashSystem), Multipath I/O, bare metal restore procedures, and enterprise wide BRMS network cluster management.  
. Deep Diagnostics & Performance: Proficiency with Collection Services, Performance Tools (PT1), PDI, Job Watcher, Disk Watcher, IBM i Doctor, and MSD analysis.  
. Security & Auditing: Security Level 40/50 enforcement, deep QAUDJRN forensics, authorization list architecture, and audit remediation.  
. Automation: Advanced CL programming, complex QSYS2 / Db2 for i SQL Services, and exposure to Ansible for IBM i or shell scripting.  
. Service Frameworks: Mature understanding of ITIL Problem Management, Change Governance, and Architectural Standards.  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
. IBM Certified System Administrator / Solution Architect – IBM i.  
. Certified High Availability Professional (e.g., Precisely Certified MIMIX Professional).  
. Direct experience architecting IBM i within Hybrid Cloud environments (e.g., IBM Power Virtual Server / PowerVS on IBM Cloud).  
. Deep experience in Ansible automation for IBM i system administration.  
. ITIL Intermediate or Expert Certification.  
  
  
Key Competencies  
  
. Masterful Diagnostic Mindset: Exceptional ability to deconstruct complex, multi tiered infrastructure failures spanning OS, hypervisor, SAN, network, and application code.  
. Decisive Crisis Leadership: Ability to take total technical command during critical production outages and execute high risk recovery actions under executive visibility.  
. Strategic Infrastructure Vision: Capacity to balance immediate operational reliability with multi year modernization and platform automation goals.  
. Technical Mentorship & Advocacy: Passion for uplifting team capabilities, mentoring L2 engineers, and evangelizing modern IBM i administrative patterns.e zones.boration with global engineering teams and operational hubs across multiple time zones.

CGI Fiscal 2024 reported revenue is CA$14.68 billion, and CGI shares are listed on the TSX (GIB.A) and the NYSE (GIB). Learn more about us at cgi.com.  
  
Job Title: Lead - Hyperion EPM & BI Infrastructure Administrator  
Position: LA / AC  
Experience: 10+ yrs.  
Job Location: Bangalore / Chennai  
Position ID: J1026-1164  
Work Type: Hybrid  
Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent  
Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.  
  
What we are looking for:  
  
We are seeking an exceptionally skilled, self-driven Lead Hyperion EPM & BI Infrastructure Administrator with over 10 years of hands-on experience to own, architect, and single handedly manage our enterprise financial systems and business intelligence infrastructure. In this role, you will be the sole point of contact and technical leader responsible for the installation, configuration, optimization, security, and migration of our Oracle Hyperion EPM Suite, Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), and Oracle Analytics Server (OAS).  
  
You will bring deep technical expertise in administering workloads in AWS Cloud, configuring highly secure Single Sign On (SSO) via Shibboleth, and maintaining high availability through custom Apache Load Balancing topologies.  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
. End to End Environment Management: Single handedly install, configure, patch, and upgrade Oracle Hyperion EPM (v11.2+), Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), and Oracle Analytics Server (OAS).  
. Administer Hyperion Foundation Services, Shared Services, Essbase, Planning, ODI , OAS & other internal third party tools & Applications.  
. Handle OBIEE/OAS server maintenance, repository (RPD) deployments, security configurations, and configure ODI agents, master/work repositories, and topology executions.  
. Develop and maintain automation scripts (MaxL, CLI, ESSCMD, Windows batch, Python, Unix shell) to automate regular maintenance, data/metadata loads, backups, and environment syncs.  
. Manage and tune underlying SQL Server databases and Oracle WebLogic Application Servers hosting the middleware  
  
Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure (AWS)
  
. Configure, scale, and optimize AWS resources including EC2, S3, EBS, EFS, VPCs, and Security Groups.  
. Use CloudFormation, Terraform, or Ansible to build, document, and provision environment stacks programmatically.  
. Disaster Recovery (DR): Establish multi AZ high availability, backup policies, AMI custom images, snapshots, and rapid recovery strategies  
  
Web Tier, Load Balancing & Security (Apache & Shibboleth)
  
. Web Server Customization: Install, configure, and harden Apache HTTP Server / Oracle HTTP Server (OHS) as the entry point reverse proxy.  
. Apache Load Balancing: Configure advanced, sticky session based load balancing using Apache module proxies to distribute traffic across clustered WebLogic JVMs.  
. Shibboleth SSO Integration: Single handedly implement, configure, and troubleshoot SAML header based Single Sign On (SSO) utilizing Shibboleth Identity Provider (IdP) integration with EPM/OAS/other Third party tools & Applications.  
. User & Certificate Governance: Manage SSL/TLS certificates across Apache servers, AWS Load Balancers, and WebLogic keystores.  
  
Special Focus: Vulnerability Monitoring, Tracking & Remediation
  
. Review and execute quarterly Oracle Critical Patch Updates (CPUs) and monthly Critical Security Patch Updates (CSPUs) for Essbase 21c, WebLogic, Hyperion, and Java SE to address critical remote code execution (RCE) and takeover vulnerabilities (such as historical flaws like CVE 2021 2109 or current high severity targets).  
. Monitor and remediate vulnerabilities in our DMZ web layer. Implement secure configurations, update Apache load balancers, enforce TLS protocol standards, and patch server side request.  
  
Required Technical Skills & Qualifications  
Must Have Experience:  
  
. 10+ years of professional experience in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Essbase, and BI middleware infrastructure administration.  
. Hands on experience with Essbase 21c, specifically configuring independent/standalone instances on top of Fusion Middleware WebLogic infrastructure.  
. Proven history of handling large scale infrastructure projects single handedly, from architecture design through to post go live support.  
. Production experience hosting enterprise workloads on AWS Cloud (utilizing EC2, VPC, EFS, and EBS).  
. High level of expertise configuring Apache Load Balancing with WebLogic cluster plugins.  
. Deep understanding of Shibboleth SSO, SAML protocol, and security certificate (SSL) management.  
. Complete familiarity with ODI and OAS console, agent, and repository administration.

title: Branch Manager
company: Renew Plus hair and Skin Clinic
description:
1. Job Summary

The Branch Manager is responsible for managing the day-to-day operations of the hair and skin care clinic, achieving branch targets, improving patient satisfaction, coordinating staff activities, and ensuring smooth clinic operations. The role involves managing appointments, monitoring revenue and performance, improving patient footfall, and implementing strategies to increase business growth.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Branch Operations Management

* Manage the daily operations of the clinic and ensure smooth functioning.
* Ensure the clinic maintains proper cleanliness, hygiene, and professional standards.
* Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, discipline, and productivity.
* Ensure treatment rooms, equipment, and supplies are ready for daily operations.
* Coordinate with doctors, nurses, telecallers, receptionists, and other staff members.

B. Business Development and Revenue Growth

* Achieve monthly branch revenue and business targets.
* Develop strategies to increase patient footfall, consultations, and treatment conversions.
* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve clinic visibility and local marketing.
* Focus on generating leads through local promotions, social media, referrals, posters, and banners.
* Build relationships with existing and potential patients to encourage repeat visits.

C. Lead and Appointment Management

* Monitor incoming leads and ensure timely follow-up by telecallers.
* Track appointment bookings, confirmations, walk-ins, cancellations, and no-shows.
* Ensure proper follow-up with patients who have enquired about hair and skin treatments.
* Coordinate doctor availability with appointment schedules.
* Review lead conversion rates and take corrective action when targets are not achieved.

D. Staff Management

* Assign responsibilities and monitor individual staff performance.
* Conduct regular team meetings to review targets and operational issues.
* Train and motivate staff to improve productivity and patient service.
* Identify performance gaps and implement improvement plans.
* Escalate staffing requirements and operational concerns to management.

E. Patient Experience and Service Quality

* Ensure patients receive professional, courteous, and timely service.
* Handle patient complaints and resolve concerns promptly.
* Monitor patient feedback, online reviews, and satisfaction levels.
* Ensure clear communication regarding appointments, consultations, treatments, and follow-ups.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and professional standards.

F. Marketing and Online Reputation

* Coordinate local marketing activities to increase branch visibility.
* Monitor the branch's social media presence and online reviews.
* Encourage genuine patient feedback in accordance with clinic policies.
* Work with the marketing team to improve lead quality and campaign performance.
* Track the effectiveness of promotional activities and report results.

G. Reporting and Documentation

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly branch performance reports.
* Track revenue, expenses, lead generation, appointments, walk-ins, and conversions.
* Maintain accurate operational and administrative records.
* Monitor inventory and coordinate timely replenishment of clinical supplies.
* Submit regular updates and performance reports to management.

H. Compliance and Safety

* Ensure compliance with applicable healthcare regulations and clinic policies.
* Maintain appropriate hygiene, infection control, and biomedical waste management practices.
* Ensure clinical services are delivered by qualified and authorized professionals.
* Protect patient information and maintain confidentiality.

3. Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field preferred.
* Previous experience in clinic management, healthcare operations, sales, or customer service.
* Experience in a dermatology, cosmetology, hair transplant, or hair and skin care clinic is an advantage.
* Strong leadership, communication, and team management skills.
* Knowledge of sales targets, lead management, and business development.
* Basic computer skills and proficiency in Excel and reporting tools.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly revenue and target achievement.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Appointment booking and confirmation rates.
* Patient walk-in and consultation numbers.
* Lead-to-consultation and consultation-to-treatment conversion rates.
* Patient satisfaction and feedback.
* Online review management and branch reputation.
* Staff productivity and attendance.
* Operational efficiency and inventory management.

5. Required Skills and Qualities

* Leadership and decision-making.
* Business development and target orientation.
* Problem-solving and conflict resolution.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Planning, organization, and time management.
* Customer relationship management.
* Ability to motivate staff and improve branch performance.

description:
**About the Job**
-----------------

About Azentio

  

Azentio Software incorporated in 2020 at Singapore, has been carved out of 3i Infotech, Candela Labs, Beyontec Technologies and Path Solutions. Azentio Software provides mission critical, vertical-specific software products for customers in banking, financial services and insurance verticals and includes key products such as KASTLE™ (Universal Lending), AMLOCK™ (Anti-Money Laundering & Compliance software suite), iMal, PREMIA™ Astra (Core Insurance software), ORION™ (Enterprise Resource Planning software) and MFUND Plus™ (Asset Management platform). Azentio has over 800 customers in more than 60 countries, with a team of over 2,300 employees across offices in 12 countries (and growing) globally and is wholly owned by Funds advised by Apax Partners.

  

Azentio offers a comprehensive range of products – serving core operations to modern digital needs – for the financial services industry. Our deep domain knowledge and solutions in financial services extend across insurance, retail and corporate lending, Islamic Banking, anti-money laundering and asset management. In addition, Azentio proudly serves mid-market enterprises across the Middle East, Africa, Asia Pacific, and India with a comprehensive ERP solution.

  

At Azentio, we believe that growth is a continuous journey. We believe that each step of this journey must be taken by committing to excellence - excellence in our products, our services, our ideas, and our people.

  

**Job Title: Associate Director – IT Infra Support Lead**

**Years of Experience: 14+ years**

**Location: Chennai**

  
  

**Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced leader to **own and scale internal IT infrastructure support and workplace technology operations**. This role is accountable for the **operating model, service quality, and outcomes** across end-user computing, office IT, collaboration platforms, and **L1/L2 infrastructure support**, with execution delivered through well-defined teams.

This is a leadership role focused on direction-setting, team enablement, and dependable IT operations at scale.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**L1/L2 Infrastructure Support & ITSM**

* Own the L1/L2 support model, including coverage, SLAs, escalation paths, and service quality.
* Lead teams supporting end-user devices, office IT, networking, email, and collaboration tools.
* Establish and run ITSM practices for incident, problem, and change management.
* Drive root cause analysis and recurring issue reduction through data and trends.

**End-User Computing & Workplace IT**

* Lead teams responsible for laptop provisioning, asset lifecycle, and workplace IT readiness.
* Own operating standards for office IT, including networking, conference rooms, and AV setups.
* Ensure consistent onboarding and offboarding experiences through defined processes.

**Microsoft /Google & Collaboration Platforms**

* Own the operational health and administration model for Microsoft 365/Google
* Ensure effective L1/L2 support for collaboration and productivity tools.
* Promote best practices to improve reliability and user productivity.
  

  

**Systems Administration**

* Provide leadership oversight for Windows/macOS systems, directory services, and endpoint management with Intune
* Ensure systems are well-documented, stable, and consistently operated, with execution owned by teams.
* Support audits related to IT operations and access controls.
  

  

**Team Leadership & Service Excellence**

* Lead, coach, and develop IT infrastructure engineers, system administrators, and L1/L2 support teams.
* Build a service-oriented culture with clear ownership and accountability.
* Track and improve key metrics such as SLA adherence, MTTR, ticket trends, and user satisfaction.

**Vendor & Cost Management**

* Own governance of IT vendors, MSPs, and service providers.
* Manage renewals, assets, vendor performance, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Ensure vendors meet agreed service and operating standards.
  

  

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 14+ years of experience in enterprise IT infrastructure support and workplace IT, with people leadership responsibility.
* Strong experience with Microsoft 365 and Google administration
* Experience in handling tools like Intune, GlobalProtect, Crowdstrike
* Experience in handline policy administration via Intune, GlobalProtect, Microsoft Entra
* Proven ability to lead teams, manage vendors, and run ITSM-driven L1/L2 operations at scale.

**Preferred Skills**

* Understanding of enterprise infrastructure setups, cloud operating models, and security fundamentals, sufficient to collaborate effectively with infrastructure and security teams.
* Working knowledge of ITIL-based service management practices.
* Strong stakeholder communication and operational leadership skills.
  

  

**What we Aim for?**

Azentio aims to be the leading provider of Banking, Financial Services & Insurance (BFSI) & Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software products in Asia Pacific, Middle East & Africa & United States. We will achieve this by:

  
  

* Providing world class software products, built on the latest technologies.
* Providing best in class customer service, built on a deep understanding of our domains and local nuances.
* Being an employer of choice, attracting high quality talent.
* Achieving top quartile growth and margins.
  

**Azentio Core Values:**

* **Customer centricity** - Put customers at the center of everything
* **Innovation** - Keep looking for a better way
* **Accountability** - Own your work, end-to-end
* **Results** - Focus on outcomes, not just effort

We take **Pride** in all that we do and together we **Enjoy** the journey

About the Role

TradeGeniuz Capital Private Limited is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Business Development Manager (BDM) to drive the company’s overall business growth.

Business Strategy & Growth

* Develop monthly, quarterly and annual business growth strategies

* Conduct market and competitor analysis

We are looking for a hands-on Business Development Manager, not someone who only manages reports or gives instructions.

About the Role

TradeGeniuz Capital Private Limited is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Business Development Manager (BDM) to drive the company’s overall business growth.

* Conduct market and competitor analysis
* Identify new products, services, partnerships and revenue opportunities
* Develop and execute go-to-market strategies

The BDM should be capable of handling the complete growth cycle:

Business Strategy → Marketing → Lead Generation → Sales → Deal Closing → Team Management → Revenue Growth

We are looking for a hands-on Business Development Manager, not someone who only manages reports or gives instructions.

The candidate should be willing to personally participate in sales and closing while simultaneously leading the Sales and Digital Marketing teams.

title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job title:** Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer**Location:** Chennai**Reports to:** Manager, IT Systems Administration**Contract:** Permanent, Full\-time**Schedule:** Shift aligning to approximately 4–5 hours of overlap with US Central Time daily; off\-hours availability required for monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests

 **Purpose of the Role**
Newell Brands is seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to join our Cloud Infrastructure team. This is a senior\-level, hands\-on role responsible for designing, securing, and operating cloud infrastructure across a multi\-cloud environment that spans Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, as well as on\-premises VMware ESXi infrastructure.  

While Microsoft Azure is the primary platform today, this role requires a strong multi\-cloud mindset and the ability to operate effectively across cloud providers as the organization's footprint evolves. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cloud security, networking, and complex troubleshooting, and can work independently with minimal direction in a globally distributed team. This role requires a work schedule providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time, as well as availability outside normal hours for scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests. Experience with VMware technologies, including VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF), is a valued plus. **Your Key Responsibilities:****Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**

* Design, deploy, and manage scalable infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud, including compute, storage, and container platforms such as AKS and EKS
* Maintain and optimize cloud account structures including Azure subscriptions, AWS accounts, and landing zones across providers
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates with a preference for cloud\-agnostic tooling where practical
* Implement automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, AWS CLI, and native cloud automation services to reduce manual effort and improve consistency
* Monitor infrastructure health across cloud platforms using Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, Log Analytics, and other native tools, responding proactively to alerts and capacity trends

**Cloud Security**

* Architect and enforce security controls across cloud environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles and a consistent multi\-cloud security posture
* Manage Azure Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC) and AWS IAM policies across cloud environments
* Conduct security assessments and remediate findings from vulnerability scans, cloud security posture tools, and policy compliance checks
* Manage secrets governance including Azure Key Vault and AWS Secrets Manager, encryption at rest and in transit, and key lifecycle management
* Maintain compliance posture across regulatory and corporate policy requirements in all cloud environments

**Cloud Networking**

* Design and manage virtual network topologies across Azure (VNets, hub\-spoke) and AWS (VPCs, Transit Gateway) with consistent routing and segmentation standards
* Configure and maintain cloud\-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), security groups, and DDoS protection across providers
* Implement and operate load balancing and traffic management services including Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Azure Front Door, and AWS equivalents
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS Zones, AWS Route 53, and name resolution across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
* Troubleshoot complex network issues across hybrid and multi\-cloud environments including routing, connectivity, and DNS resolution failures

**Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**

* Serve as a senior escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents across all platforms, driving rapid diagnosis and resolution
* Lead post\-incident reviews, document root cause analyses, and implement preventive measures
* Use platform\-native diagnostics and log analytics tools to investigate performance degradation and outages
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure support as needed

**Maintenance, DR, \& Business Continuity**

* Actively participate in monthly infrastructure maintenance windows, which are scheduled outside of normal business hours
* Support semi\-annual disaster recovery (DR) tests, including failover validation, documentation, and post\-test reporting
* Contribute to DR planning and runbook development to ensure recovery procedures remain current and tested across cloud environments

**On\-Premises \& Collaboration**

* Support VMware ESXi and on\-premises virtualization environments as needed
* Contribute to cloud adoption and migration projects, providing multi\-cloud expertise during design and execution phases
* Share technical knowledge across the team; contribute to infrastructure standards, runbooks, and architectural decision records

 **What You’ll Need:****Minimum:*** 6\+ years of hands\-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong depth in at least two major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS strongly preferred)
* Demonstrated expertise in cloud security fundamentals including RBAC/IAM, Zero Trust principles, secrets governance, and encryption; working knowledge of Entra ID, Conditional Access, and PIM
* Strong cloud networking skills spanning virtual networks, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and Private DNS Zones across Azure and AWS
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex issues across compute, storage, networking, and identity layers in a multi\-cloud environment
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates
* Proficiency in cloud automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and/or AWS CLI
* Familiarity with cloud monitoring and observability tools across providers (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, AWS CloudWatch)
* Comfortable working outside normal hours to support scheduled monthly maintenance windows and semi\-annual DR tests
* Ability to work a shift providing approximately 4–5 hours of daily overlap with US Central Time
* Strong documentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Business\-level English proficiency (verbal and written) required
* Ability to work independently and effectively in a fully remote environment across global time zones.

 **Your Advantage:*** Cloud certifications — one or more of the following are preferred:
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ\-305\)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ\-500\)
* AZ\-700: Designing and Implementing Microsoft Azure Networking Solutions
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator – Associate or Professional
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty
* Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF9\) or prior VMware vSphere/ESXi administration
* Exposure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) in a production environment
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tooling such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions

title: Salesforce Quality Analyst
description:
**3\+ Years of Experience**
---------------------------


### **Location: Coimbatore**

  

  

### **Role Overview**


We are looking for an experienced **Salesforce Quality Analyst** with 3\+ years of experience in software testing and strong expertise in **Salesforce application testing**. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, functionality, performance, and reliability of Salesforce solutions across implementation, enhancement, integration, and data migration projects.


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Analyze **Salesforce requirements, specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria** to create detailed test plans, test scenarios, and test cases.
* Perform functional and regression testing across Salesforce applications, including **Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and customized Salesforce solutions**.
* Develop and execute **manual and automated test cases** for Salesforce applications.
* Validate Salesforce configurations, including **Objects, Fields, Validation Rules, Workflows/Flows, Approval Processes, Profiles, Roles, Permission Sets, and Reports**.
* Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects using tools such as **Jira and** **Monday.com**.
* Collaborate with **Salesforce Developers, Consultants, Business Analysts, and stakeholders** to investigate and resolve defects.
* Perform **regression testing** for Salesforce enhancements, fixes, releases, and deployments.
* Conduct **API and integration testing** to validate data exchange between Salesforce and external systems.
* Perform **Salesforce data migration testing**, including data validation, data integrity, field mapping, and record reconciliation.
* Validate business processes and end\-to\-end workflows across Salesforce and integrated applications.
* Perform **UAT support** and assist business stakeholders in validating Salesforce solutions against business requirements.
* Monitor and maintain defect logs while performing **root\-cause analysis** for recurring issues.
* Ensure testing activities are aligned with **Salesforce release and deployment cycles**.
* Stay updated with Salesforce platform features, testing tools, QA methodologies, and industry best practices.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of **Salesforce QA processes, test automation, and testing methodologies**.
  

  

### **Qualifications**


* **3\+ years of proven experience in Quality Assurance / Software Testing**, preferably with significant experience in Salesforce testing.
* Hands\-on experience in **Salesforce application testing**.
* Strong knowledge of **manual testing and automation testing**.
* Good understanding of Salesforce configuration and business processes.
* Experience testing **Salesforce Sales Cloud / Service Cloud** or similar Salesforce implementations.
* Strong understanding of **functional, integration, regression, system, and UAT testing**.
* Experience with **API testing tools and methodologies**.
